About QuikStor  


QuikStor is the leading SaaS facility management platform for the self\-storage industry, delivering a purpose\-built, scalable system that serves as the foundation for intelligent automation and modern facility operations. We are in rapid growth mode, backed by significant capital from self\-storage industry veterans who share our vision to build the most advanced and scalable operating system for storage operators worldwide.  


Role Overview  


The Implementation Manager is a customer\-facing, product\-expert role responsible for translating a customer’s business requirements into a clearly defined QuikStor system configuration. This role sits between Sales, Project Management, and Implementation Execution, and is critical to ensuring successful, scalable deployments.  


Implementation Managers are not project managers and are not solely focused on task tracking or timelines. Instead, they serve as trusted advisors and product experts who understand both QuikStor and the self\-storage industry. They work directly with customers to define workflows, configurations, and operational requirements, then hand off clear, complete implementation specifications to the Implementation Execution team.  


Success in this role is measured by implementation quality, customer confidence, reduction in rework, and smooth handoff to execution teams.  


Key Responsibilities  


Customer Discovery \& Requirements Definition  


Lead detailed discovery sessions with customers to understand their operational workflows, policies, and business requirements  
Advise customers on best practices and recommended configurations within the QuikStor platform  
Identify gaps between current customer processes and QuikStor\-native workflows, and guide customers toward scalable solutions  


Product Configuration \& Solution Design  


Define how QuikStor should be configured to meet customer needs, including leasing, billing, delinquency, access control, reporting, and integrations  
Translate customer requirements into clear, structured implementation specifications  
Ensure configurations align with QuikStor best practices, compliance requirements, and long\-term scalability  


Implementation Handoff \& Execution Support

Partner closely with Project Management to ensure scope, assumptions, and dependencies are clearly understood

Cross\-Functional Collaboration

Collaborate with Support to ensure smooth post\-go\-live transitions  


Customer Confidence \& Enablement  


Serve as a trusted product expert for customers throughout the implementation lifecycle  
Help customers understand not just how the system is configured, but why

Required Qualifications  


3 to 6\+ years of experience in SaaS implementation, onboarding, or solutions consulting  
Deep understanding of complex, configurable B2B SaaS platforms  
Strong customer\-facing communication and discovery skills

High attention to detail and strong documentation discipline

Prior experience in the self\-storage industry

jobs.title: Risk Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**
The **Risk Program Manager** develops, implements, and continuously improves enterprise risk programs that strengthen field awareness, standardize risk practices, and support the organization’s insurance and loss\-prevention objectives. Serving as a strategic partner to operational leadership, this role uses risk data, insurance insights, and field engagement to identify emerging exposures, improve risk controls, and influence practical mitigation strategies across a large, geographically distributed branch network. The Risk Program Manager serves as the functional owner of key risk systems and resources, including Origami, incident reporting workflows, dashboards, risk communications, and field\-facing training.  

The Risk Program Manager also owns the company’s certificate of insurance (COI) management program, leads the COI Administrator, supports claims and insurance program analytics, and contributes to annual renewal and underwriting activities. Working in close partnership with Safety, Operations, Legal, Finance, Procurement, insurance brokers, carriers, and other partners, the role translates incident trends, claims information, insurance requirements, and operational needs into scalable programs and actionable recommendations. This is an opportunity to help shape and strengthen FBM’s risk\-management capabilities during a period of significant organizational growth and transformation. **Key Responsibilities****Risk Program Development \& Management*** Build, enhance, and govern enterprise risk programs, including incident reporting, claims workflows, loss\-prevention initiatives, and field mitigation programs.
* Serve as the functional owner and administrator of Origami, including configuration, workflows, notifications, dashboards, reporting, data quality, user adoption, and continuous platform improvement.
* Develop and maintain centralized risk resources, standards, templates, guides, and field\-facing materials that support consistent execution across branches and business units.
* Establish program governance, decision criteria, and escalation practices that improve accountability, responsiveness, and consistency across risk\-management processes.
* Publish recurring risk communications, including a risk newsletter, to drive awareness, education, and engagement.


**COI \& Third\-Party Risk Program Oversight*** Own the full certificate of insurance (COI) management program, lead the COI Administrator, and oversee the end\-to\-end COI lifecycle.
* Establish and maintain standards for COI intake, verification, retention, exceptions, escalation, and documentation.
* Monitor COI compliance, turnaround time, recurring deficiencies, and other program metrics; recommend process or control improvements based on trends and business needs.
* Partner with Legal, Procurement, Operations, and other stakeholders to support vendor compliance and consistent application of insurance requirements.
* Develop and deliver training on COI requirements, vendor compliance, and documentation standards.


**Insurance \& Claims Program Support*** Support annual insurance renewals, exposure data collection, underwriting submissions, broker coordination, and responses to carrier or underwriter information requests.
* Analyze exposure, loss, and claims information to identify trends, data\-quality issues, and opportunities to improve insurance program performance and risk mitigation.
* Support claims reporting processes and periodic claims reviews with internal stakeholders, brokers, carriers, and third\-party administrators, as applicable.
* Develop field\-facing guidance explaining coverage, deductibles, reporting requirements, claim\-reporting expectations, and risk\-management best practices.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and insurance partners to support timely, accurate information exchange and effective program administration.


**Field Risk Awareness, Training \& Operational Partnership*** Create and deliver risk\-awareness training modules, tools, and communications for field leaders and branch teams.
* Build strong relationships with field and functional leaders and influence adoption of risk\-management practices without relying on formal authority.
* Identify emerging risk trends and partner with Operations and Safety to develop targeted mitigation strategies, corrective actions, and practical field solutions.
* Serve as a primary liaison between Risk Management and Operations to ensure clarity, consistency, responsiveness, and effective issue resolution.
* Use risk resources, training, and recurring communications to reinforce field awareness and consistent risk practices across the organization.


**Risk Analytics \& Continuous Improvement*** Define and maintain key risk indicators, program metrics, scorecards, and dashboards, including measures related to incident frequency and severity, reporting timeliness, COI compliance, claims trends, training adoption, and process effectiveness where data is available.
* Produce monthly and quarterly incident, claims, and risk trend analyses and executive\-level reporting that highlight material exposures, root causes, and recommended actions.
* Independently evaluate risk data and operational feedback to identify emerging exposures, recurring issues, control gaps, and opportunities for scalable improvement.
* Recommend and help implement changes to processes, controls, training, workflows, and system configuration based on performance, business impact, and evolving risk needs.
* Develop repeatable processes, governance standards, templates, and planning tools that improve speed, quality, consistency, and accountability across risk programs.
* Communicate program performance, material risks, and recommendations to senior stakeholders in a concise, decision\-oriented manner.


**Additional Responsibilities*** Lead special projects and perform other duties assigned by management.

  

**Qualifications*** Bachelor’s deg

jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Business Operations Analyst

**Team:** Operations

**Location:** Onsite \- Sawtelle (Between Santa Monica \& West LA)

**Employment Type:** Fulltime, Salary, Exempt

**Reports To:** Sr. Director Marketing Operations

**About Plug**
--------------


Plug is an automotive fintech startup building the marketplace for electric vehicles. Consumers, dealers, and commercial partners trade in, sell, and auction used EVs through a platform built exclusively for electric, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive.


Consumers can get an instant cash offer in minutes, backed by data\-driven pricing, battery state\-of\-health analysis, with pickup, payment, and title transfer handled end\-to\-end. Franchise and independent dealers across the United States bid in real time on inventory sourced directly from these consumers, dealers, and commercial partners. The result is a single platform that gives sellers a fast, fair exit and gives dealers a dedicated channel for sourcing used EV inventory.


Founded in 2023 and led by former Tesla executives, Plug has facilitated $100M in EV sales since launch and is backed by a $20M Series A from Lightspeed Venture Partners. We're building the most AI\-native startup team in Los Angeles, full of operators, engineers, and ML researchers laying the transaction rails for the used EV market's exponential growth.

**Why Plug**
------------

* You'll own a piece of the biggest infrastructure opportunity in automotive.
* You'll work on a platform built exclusively for EVs, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive.
* You'll be part of an AI\-native company. We're rethinking how work gets done at a fundamental level.
* You'll work directly with operators who have scaled multi\-billion dollar businesses in automotive, EV, and marketplaces.
* You'll have real ownership, high autonomy, and a direct line to company outcomes.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------


You'll report to the Director of Business Operations and be the go\-to person for turning data into decisions. You'll build and maintain the dashboards and models that track how the business is performing, prepare the analysis and slides that go in front of leadership, and use AI tools \- including building your own lightweight agents and automations over time \- to enhance your workflow and support broader AI adoption across the organization.


You'll support the Director of BizOps on cross\-functional initiatives and KPI tracking, bringing depth and speed on the numbers to the work.

**What You’ll Own**
-------------------

**Analytics \& Reporting**

* Build and maintain BI dashboards (Metabase/Snowflake or equivalent) covering auction performance, dealer operations, vehicle flow, and pricing
* Define and track success metrics for BizOps\-led initiatives, so leaders always know whether a project is actually working
* Build clear, exec\-ready slides and reports for recurring leadership reviews

**AI \& Workflow Automation**

* Use AI tools to speed up and automate recurring analysis and reporting work.
* Build lightweight agents or automated pipelines for repeatable requests.
* Bring a builder's mindset to your own workflow and workflow of other teams

**Analysis \& Business Partnership**

* Run deep\-dive analyses to explain why a metric moved
* Translate data into a clear point of view for non\-technical stakeholders

**What You Are**
----------------

* 2\-3 years of experience in business operations, data analytics, strategy \& ops, or a similarly analytical role (marketplace or automotive experience a plus, not required).
* Hands\-on comfort building dashboards in a BI tool (Metabase, Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent).
* Curiosity and hands\-on comfort with AI tools for analysis and workflow automation
* Strong slide\-building and communication skills — you can turn a messy dataset into something a VP can read in ten seconds.
* Business acumen: you understand why a metric matters to the business, not just how to compute it.
* Build the analytical backbone of a company at the center of the EV transition.
* Ship work quickly and see the impact of your analysis show up in real decisions, fast.
* Work directly with operators who've scaled multi\-billion\-dollar businesses in automotive, EV, and marketplaces.
* Join a team that values clarity, ownership, and a bias toward action.

**Compensation and Benefits**
-----------------------------


Annual salary: L2 $85,000 \- $105,000

*Salary ranges reflect independent, third\-party benchmarking against national compensation data. Where an individual's actual offer falls within that range depends on a combination of factors, including relevant experience, specialized skills, training and qualifications, current business needs, and prevailing market conditions. Ranges are reviewed periodically and may be adjusted to reflect changing market conditions.*


Benefits \& Perks:

* Health, Vision, and Dental insurance
* 401(k) plan
* Daily lunch stipend
* Equity (based on role and performance)
* Unlimited PTO
* Fully stocked kitchen
* Dog\-friendly office
* 30\-day remote work from anywhere policy
* Ongoing opportunities for growth and development

  

This full\-time position is based in Sawtelle (between Santa Monica and West Los Angeles) and is an in\-person role. We welcome candidates from all locations to apply, provided they are willing to relocate for the role. Relocation assistance will not be provided for successful candidates. Sponsorship not available at this time.

**Acknowledgments**


Plug is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We believe diverse teams build better products \- full stop.

jobs.title: Dealing Technology – Tech lead / Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
-----------------------

  

  

In July 2024, Natixis Investment Managers (Natixis IM), ranked among the leading asset managers in the world with over €1,250 billion in assets under management, created Natixis Investment Managers Operating Services (Natixis IM Operating Services) as part of its strategic plan.  

A centralized service platform in the fields of technology and operations dedicated to asset management, Natixis IM Operating Services encompasses Middle\-Office, Data, Reporting, Technology, and Innovation functions to promote operational excellence and thereby maximize the value proposition for its clients.  

Natixis IM Operating Services is implementing a strategy aimed at delivering an ambitious transformation and investment program, fostering innovation, and continuously enhancing its offerings in response to current and future challenges in the Asset and Wealth Management sector.  

  

**Job Description**
-------------------

  

  

**POSITION AND MISSIONS**Dealing Technology is responsible for the platforms used by trading tables for Natixis Investment Managers' affiliates as part of its financial services platform, both within the Natixis group and for external clients.


Intermediation is a market activity consisting in receiving orders from management companies and transmitting them to financial markets (brokers, organised markets, execution platforms) as quickly and efficiently as possible on any traded asset class.


This demanding activity requires responsiveness and efficiency from both systems and teams in order to process an order flow in near real time.


The IT Dealing information system is built around the OMS Charles River, coupled with the main market execution platforms (TSOX, Tradeweb, Triton, FXAll, RFQ Hub, LiquidNet, etc.) as well as internal applications for receiving orders (web portal, FIX engine). In an ever\-changing environment, we are increasingly integrating innovative technologies to optimize our performance, safety and processes.


The field has about 12 employees divided into two teams: technical analysts (BA team) and technical experts/developers (Tech Team).


It is within the Technology team composed of 5 people that you will join the domain in order to manage and coordinate the activity directly with the manager of the field.


On a daily basis, your tasks include (but are not limited to):


**Manage the activity of the Technology team**

In collaboration with the other team leaders and the field manager, ensure the management of the team composed of MOE, technical experts, and integration project manager.


You ensure the follow\-up of team tasks according to the methodologies in force within the field and more generally within NIMOS IT, the coordination with other teams within and outside the field (architecture, application production...) and the tracking of suppliers across the entire application scope.


You will be involved in the implementation of Agile governance, demonstrations, and various workshops. Participation in daily meetings to maintain constant contact with the professions for which the team operates.


**Participate in the development of projects in the field**

In collaboration with the other members of the team (MOE, MOA, Project Managers), you will participate in the development of new applications or the functional evolutions of applications already in production. You will also be required to work on certain decommissioning applications.


You will be a driving force for improvement and innovation opportunities in the field, notably by exploiting the potential of Artificial Intelligence (AI) for flow optimization or process automation.


You will take cybersecurity issues into account in technological decisions and developments, in collaboration with the dedicated teams.


**Keep applications operational:**

You will contribute, with the rest of the team, to implement and continuously improve processes in order to maximize tool availability and user satisfaction.


You will collaborate with security teams for surveillance, incident response and continuous improvement of system protection measures in the field.


In this context, you will be in contact with the business and the various IT teams at NIMOS, as well as the operational risk management teams, and with the teams from the Natixis\-BPCE group responsible for technical infrastructure and application production.


You will also be in coordination with the project team of the field within the framework of developments identified via the support channel and requiring the launch of a project.


**Architecture and monitoring of team skills:**

You will contribute, with the rest of the internal team to monitor and report on the technical and methodological skills needs of the field. You will organize the interviews of external consultants (providers) according to project needs.


You will be involved in architectural discussions and propose improvements to new technologies on the market.


You will conduct a strategic watch on advances in AI and cybersecurity applicable to our field, and assess their potential for adoption.


You will transmit the AI and cybersecurity culture within the Tech team, encouraging the acquisition of new skills in these areas.

  

  

The position is based in Paris, in the 13th arrondissement, with the possibility to work remotely.


As a Top Employer, we place our employees at the center of our attention. Internal mobility, career development and training programs allow you to grow and flourish throughout your journey.


You work in a hybrid, inclusive and collaborative working environment.


You also have the opportunity to engage in favor of society and causes that are important to you through our corporate foundation.

jobs.title: Principal Program Manager
jobs.description:
Assured is on a mission to modernize insurance. Claims processing (i.e. should we pay this claim?), while often overlooked, is the foundation of the entire industry. It’s currently highly manual, involving phone calls, faxes, and gut instinct, costing tens of billions of dollars a year. We can do better.


At Assured, we provide large insurers with the software solutions they need to win in a modern, technology\-driven world. From self\-service claim\-filing software to backend fraud detection, we’re the engine that powers claims processing for some of the largest insurers in the world.


The challenges we face are deep and diverse, from creating digital experiences that provide comfort and clarity to claimants at their most stressed and vulnerable to orchestrating large\-scale ML\-driven decision\-making on billions of dollars of claims payments, life at Assured is dynamic, collaborative, and rewarding.


We’re looking for an experienced **Principal Program Manager** to join our Client Engagement team.


In this role, you’ll help turn complex client priorities into clear, executable programs across Client Engagement, Product, Engineering, and client stakeholders. You’ll own the operating rhythm for high\-stakes client initiatives, from kickoff and scoping through launch, adoption, and long\-term success.


This is a role for someone who can bring structure to ambiguity, keep cross\-functional work moving, and build trust with both internal teams and enterprise customers.


P\&C insurance industry experience is a strong plus, but not required. What matters most is the ability to learn the domain quickly and build credibility with enterprise clients.

**Some of the Work You’ll Own:**
--------------------------------


**Turn client needs into clear execution plans.**  

Sit between Product, Engineering, and client stakeholders to translate client priorities into scoped initiatives, owners, timelines, risks, and next steps.


**Drive high\-stakes carrier initiatives from kickoff to launch.**  

Own the operating plan for client\-facing projects, including dependencies, decision points, launch readiness, stakeholder alignment, and the many details that determine whether a rollout feels controlled or chaotic.


**Build the Client Engagement operating muscle.**  

Create the intake, tracking, status, and escalation rhythms that help Client Engagement manage carrier work consistently as Assured scales.


**Make risks and tradeoffs visible early.**  

When timelines shift, scope expands, or dependencies get stuck, surface the issue clearly, frame the options, and help the right people make the right call before it becomes a client\-facing fire drill.


**Be the translator across clients and internal teams.**  

Turn carrier feedback, asks, and concerns into clear internal action. Turn Product and Engineering constraints into client\-ready explanations that build confidence instead of confusion.


**Find patterns across client work.**  

Notice when multiple carriers are asking for the same thing, running into the same friction, or needing the same support, and help turn those patterns into better processes, product improvements, or scalable client programs.


**Keep multiple concurrent initiatives balanced and honest.**  

Manage the mechanics that keep complex work moving, including RAID logs, dependency mapping, launch plans, follow\-ups, status reporting, and critical path management, without adding process for process’s sake.

**How You'll Make an Impact:**
------------------------------

**Improve confidence in client delivery.**  

Help Assured give enterprise clients clearer visibility, tighter execution, and more predictable launches across complex initiatives. You’ll build trust by being organized, precise, and honest about what is known, unknown, and changing.


**Keep everyone aligned without meeting overload.**  

Build clear status updates, trackers, launch plans, and decision logs so leadership, Client Engagement, Product, Engineering, and client stakeholders can understand where things stand without needing another meeting just to find the answer.


**Use AI to move faster.**  

Use tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and similar platforms to draft project plans, synthesize client feedback, maintain documentation, identify risks, and keep work moving without letting coordination consume the week.


**Help scale Client Engagement.**  

As Assured grows, Client Engagement needs better systems for managing client commitments, launches, escalations, and cross\-functional work. You’ll help build the operating model that lets the team scale without losing the high\-touch client experience.

**You'll Probably Thrive Here If You:**
---------------------------------------


**Have deep program management experience.**  

You’ve led complex, cross\-functional work with real stakeholder pressure, shifting timelines, ambiguous requirements, and external customers in the mix. You know how to create structure, drive alignment, and keep teams moving when the path is not perfectly defined.


**Are client\-facing and internally rigorous.**  

You can communicate clearly with client stakeholders, then turn around and drive internal follow\-through with the right level of detail.


**Are comfortable being technical\-adjacent.**  

You don’t need to write code, but you need to understand product and engineering constraints well enough to ask good questions, scope honestly, and avoid hand\-wavy commitments.


**Can operate without waiting for perfect clarity.**  

You know how to create structure when the path is still forming. You can identify what matters, what’s blocked, who owns what, and what decision needs to happen next.


**Balance urgency with discipline.**  

You move quickly, but you don’t skip the basics: owners, dates, risks, dependencies, decisions, and follow\-up.


**Lead through influence.**  

You know how to get people moving together by being clear, trusted, and relentlessly organized.

Our unprecedented global expansion has provided us with the opportunity to offer a large number of new positions to the technology community. We seek talented, passionate, and committed engineers, technologists, and business leaders to join us.  

  



**Job Summary:**
----------------


Supermicro is seeking a Project Manager to lead and scale Salesforce\-driven service operations initiatives across global teams. This role will serve as the operational bridge between business shareholders, Salesforce administrators, external development and vendor partners, and IT system owners.

  

  

The ideal candidate combines structured project leadership with hands\-on coordination across Salesforce, system integration (APIs), and service operations workflows. This individual will drive execution across development cycles, incident management, backlog prioritization, and cross\-system automation efforts. This role is remote across California, Arizona, Texas, Colorado, Nevada, or Utah.


**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
------------------------------------------


**Includes the following essential duties and responsibilities (other duties may also be assigned):**
  

* Lead daily Salesforce development standups and end\-of\-day review sessions.
* Coordinate development lifecycle across Dev, UAT, and Production environments.
* Maintain and continuously prioritize the Salesforce Master Backlog.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to drive execution, resolve challenges, and ensure timely project delivery.
* Facilitate communication between global teams, ensuring seamless project execution across regions.
* Utilize project management tools such as JIRA, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Team, Slack, etc. to track progress and report updates.
* Ensure QA validation and user acceptance criteria are met prior to release.
* Partner with external development vendors (e.g., offshore teams) to drive delivery and remove blockers.
* Lead coordination of API integration efforts between Salesforce and enterprise systems.

**Other Responsibilities:**
  

* Drive structural backlog grooming and prioritization across projects, incidents, and enhancements.
* Identify automation opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiencies.
* Partner with IT and system owners to define integration architecture and automation strategy.
* Facilitate cross\-functional requirements gathering sessions.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------


* 5\+ years of experience in managing project management, preferably in Salesforce or enterprise SaaS platform initiatives.
* Experience leading Dev UAT Production release cycles.
* Strong experience with MS Office suite, and Smartsheet.
* Strong understanding of API integrations and cross\-system architecture.
* Experience working with offshore development partners.
* Familiarity with Service Cloud or enterprise ticketing systems is strongly preferred.
* Salesforce certifications (Admin, Developer, etc.) or ability to obtain in 30\-60 days from hire
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally as needed.


**Salary Range**
----------------


$120,000 \- $140,000


The salary offered will depend on several factors, including your location, level, education, training, specific skills, years of experience, and comparison to other employees already in this role. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation, such as participation in bonus and equity award programs.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Requisition ID \# 170610
  
  

**Job Category:** Project / Program Management
  
**Job Level:** Individual Contributor
  
**Business Unit:** Energy Delivery
  
**Work Type:** Hybrid
  
**Job Location:** San Ramon
  
  

Department Overview
  
  

Engineering, Planning \& Strategy will play a leading role in showing California and the world how PG\&E will meet California’s decarbonization and resilience goals while improving safety, affordability and reliability. The Large Load Project Management Team is responsible for delivering complex, high\-capacity electric infrastructure projects that support major commercial and industrial customers. These projects often involve multi\-phase transmission and distribution upgrades, regulatory compliance, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders to meet customer timelines and strategic commitments.
  
  

Position Summary
  
  

This job is represented by Engineers and Scientists of California (ESC) subject to collective bargaining.
  
  

This position, under general direction, exercises judgment and discretion and is responsible for all aspects of the development and implementation of assigned projects and provides a single point of contact for those projects. Project duration is generally multi\-year, requires significant risk management, and may include formal partnering agreements with outside firms. Assignments will have high visibility, require extensive project management skills and often require specific discipline and areas of expertise, such as:
  
  

Electric transmission substation projects
  
Electric transmission line projects
  
  

This position is hybrid, working from your remote office and your assigned work location based on business need.
  
  

PG\&E is providing the salary range that the company in good faith believes it might pay for this position at the time of the job posting. This compensation range is specific to the locality of the job. The actual salary paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, geographic location, collective bargaining agreements, and internal equity. Although we estimate the successful candidate hired into this role will be placed towards the middle or entry point of the range, the decision will be made on a case\-by\-case basis related to these factors.
  
  

**The salary range is:**  

CA Minimum, $161,520
  
CA Maximum, $207,504
  
  

Job Responsibilities
  
  

Provides leadership, coaching, technical direction, and oversight for assigned projects; also provides knowledge transfer and assistance to many technical and/or project management employees and teams.
  
Proactively controls the scope, schedule, cost, and quality of a large portfolio of projects throughout the project life cycle.
  
Provides extensive knowledge and guidance to others in start\-up testing, inspections, and condition assessment; actively supports complex and/or large project start\-up tests and field inspections.
  
Provides guidance to engineering on producing complex risk and alternative analyses, studies and conceptual designs for presentation to project sponsors and/or leadership.
  
Oversees and administrates EPC contracts.
  
Negotiates third party contracts, in support of other departments when appropriate.
  
Makes presentations to PG\&E Officers as appropriate.
  
Arbitrates and resolves conflicts within the project.
  
Mentors and provides guidance to less experienced project managers.
  
  

Qualifications
  
  

**Minimum:**  

Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) from an accredited college\*
  
8 years of PG\&E (9 years outside) of relevant experience in electric, gas, or power generation operations, engineering, business planning, accounting, finance, construction management, or project management
  
Active Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
  
  

* In lieu of a four (4\) year degree, candidates may qualify with twelve (12\) or more years of directly related work experience in areas such as accounting, engineering, construction management, project scheduling, or project controls, with responsibilities comparable to those outlined for this role. External hires must have a minimum of thirteen (13\) years of applicable experience.


**Desired:**  

Electrical Engineering Degree for the Substation projects and Civil Engineering for Transmission line projects
  
Knowledge of and experience with electric substations, and transmission line projects
  
Fluent in the use of Project Management tools and current company tools, such as SAP Financials and Work Management modules and Microsoft Project Scheduling Software
  
Superior ability to interface with and across supporting organizations and conduct formal presentations to officers.
  
Knowledge of land acquisition, CPUC and environmental permitting, and EPC contracting procedures.
  
Demonstrated ability to lead multiple medium to large scale complex projects; provide resolution of complex technical and/or contractual issues; and/or provide Project Management on multiple projects with complex scope requiring non\-standard approaches; without supervision.
  
Demonstrated application of extensive project management skills, including seasoned and experience\-based judgment and organizational business acumen in applying and adapting traditional project management techniques.
  
Demonstrates extensive contracting knowledge and contract negotiation and management skills.
  
Demonstrates excellent verbal and written communication skills, utilizes a variety of styles to connect with the intended audience, and able to present complex information to upper management on a variety of topics.
  
Builds consensus around complex and controversial project \& technical issues.
  
Demonstrated high quality work by self and others on project team.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Supply Chain, Google Beam
jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in program management.
* Experience with supply chain planning.
* Experience with hardware product development.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 8 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.


Google Beam is a true\-to\-life new communication technology from Google that allows people to feel like they’re having real face\-to\-face conversations, no matter the distance. Powered by realistic state\-of\-the\-art 3D imaging and spatial audio and integrated with today’s leading remote video platforms, Google Beam enables you to be immersed in the moment, together. As a part of the Google Beam team, you'll work with incredible teammates across all major functions in a fast\-paced product\-oriented environment. Your contributions will have an impact on the future of communications with Google products. You will apply technology to solve that really important problem that we often want to be together and we can’t.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $192000 \- $278000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Implement communications standards across a portfolio of programs including executive and key partner communications.
* Establish a reliable and visible cadence for program reviews, decision\-making, prioritization, and resource stewardship (effective deployment of machine and people resources) whereby improvements such as efficiency and utilization gains are measurable and the impact can be felt organization wide.
* Lead a governance structure that drives effective executive decision\-making. Ensure governance structure effectively exposes and mitigates dependencies.
* Seek out and identify change management opportunities that increase program velocity and which affect multiple teams.
* Define/manage a program portfolio solving problems that target high business impact for the organization and product area.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next\-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

  

  

**What We Offer**

  

Salary:


$164,000\.00 \- $225,500\.00
Location:


Santa Clara,CA

We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.


At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits .

Operating at the intersection of HR Centers of Excellence (COEs), Global Information Services (GIS), and HR leadership, this role provides enterprise\-level portfolio oversight, governance leadership, and strategic planning support to ensure initiatives align with business objectives and deliver measurable outcomes.


As a senior individual contributor, this role influences without direct authority, bringing executive\-level rigor, visibility, and accountability to the HR investment portfolio. The Director partners closely with the HR Technology Leader, COE executives, and the VP of Employee Experience to establish strategic priorities, guide investment decisions, identify organizational risks, and drive alignment across a complex portfolio of initiatives.


This role does not directly manage project execution teams but serves as the senior leader responsible for ensuring that appropriate governance, planning disciplines, prioritization frameworks, and delivery mechanisms are in place to enable successful outcomes.


The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in portfolio management, HR transformation, enterprise technology delivery, and organizational change leadership, with the executive presence necessary to influence senior leaders and navigate highly matrixed environments.


### **Enterprise Portfolio Strategy \& Governance**


* Lead the strategic governance and oversight of the HR transformation and HR technology portfolio, ensuring initiatives align with enterprise priorities, resource capacity, and business outcomes.
* Establish portfolio prioritization frameworks, investment criteria, and governance standards used to evaluate and sequence HR initiatives.
* Provide executive\-level visibility into portfolio health, dependencies, risks, resource constraints, and delivery outcomes across the HR function.
* Facilitate portfolio\-level decision making among HR leadership, COEs, and GIS partners, balancing competing priorities and organizational needs.
* Drive portfolio reviews with senior stakeholders, ensuring alignment on strategic objectives, delivery commitments, and investment tradeoffs.

* Serve as a trusted advisor to the VP of Employee Experience and HR leadership team on portfolio strategy, delivery health, risk management, and organizational readiness.
* Partner closely with HR Technology leadership to align technology investments, roadmap priorities, and transformation objectives across the HR ecosystem.
* Anticipate and proactively address portfolio\-level risks that may impact business objectives, adoption outcomes, or delivery timelines.
* Influence executive stakeholders and functional leaders to drive alignment and accountability across complex cross\-functional initiatives.
* Provide recommendations regarding investment decisions, prioritization changes, resource allocations, and mitigation strategies.

### **HR Transformation \& Roadmap Leadership**


* Lead the development and ongoing evolution of the multi\-year HR transformation roadmap in partnership with HR leadership and GIS stakeholders.
* Facilitate strategic planning processes that translate business priorities into executable HR and technology initiatives.
* Evaluate interdependencies across programs and identify opportunities to consolidate efforts, improve efficiency, and maximize organizational impact.
* Ensure roadmap priorities are supported by appropriate governance, resource plans, and change readiness strategies.
* Drive annual and quarterly portfolio planning cycles, supporting executive decision\-making and investment prioritization.

### **Enterprise Delivery Excellence**


* Champion adoption of portfolio management disciplines, governance frameworks, and delivery standards across HR.
* Assess organizational delivery maturity and identify opportunities to improve consistency, predictability, and execution effectiveness.
* Establish executive reporting mechanisms and success metrics that provide meaningful insight into portfolio performance and business value realization.
* Lead lessons learned reviews and continuous improvement efforts to strengthen portfolio execution capabilities across the HR organization.
* Identify systemic obstacles impacting project delivery and recommend structural improvements to increase organizational effectiveness.

VideoLabs is seeking a Technical Project Manager to lead the development and implementation of a workflow management system supporting our core internal IP processes (e.g., patent analysis, ranking, case development) and the parallel evaluation of future Asset Management and CRM systems. You'll review and document our internal processes, define base\-level system requirements, and guide the company in selecting, implementing, and configuring the most suitable SaaS workflow management system (e.g., Asana, Trello, Wrike) to improve productivity and collaboration. You'll run gap analyses across the company, gather requirements, project\-manage the effort end to end, and introduce automation and sustainable new technologies enabling VideoLabs to scale effectively and efficiently as it grows.


### **Description**


**Job Title: Technical Project Manager**

**Location:** San Francisco Bay Area (Hybrid)

**Reports To:** COO

**Hours:** Full\-Time


Comp: DOE, $140\-180k base


Must be legally authorized to work for any US employer without sponsorship.

 **The Company**

**Organization:** The Surplus Line Association of California (SLA)

**Come join our team — we’d love to have you!**


At the SLA, we take pride in fostering an open, inclusive, and collaborative culture where employees come first. Our commitment to creating an exceptional workplace has earned us recognition:

* Certified as a Great Place to Work® three years in a row
* Named one of California’s Best Workplaces for 2025


As an employee\-first organization, we’re passionate about supporting our team inside and outside the workplace.


We offer:

If you’re looking to grow your career in an environment where your voice is heard, your contributions are valued, and fun is part of the culture — come join us!

**About Us:**


At the Surplus Line Association of California (SLA), we don’t sell insurance—we protect access to it. As the only organization overseeing California’s $20\+ billion surplus lines insurance marketplace, we help support coverage availability for businesses—from film studios to freight haulers—when risks are too complex, too large or too unique for the standard market.


Each year we review more than 1 million policy transactions, equip insurance brokers with compliance tools and continuing education courses, monitor the financial stability of global insurers and deliver data\-driven insights that help the industry stay ahead of emerging risks. That impact—combined with our strong employee culture—has earned us recognition by Fortune as one of the Bay Area’s best places to work.

**Quick Clarifier:**


We are not insurance agents or a government agency—and we won’t be quoting your car or life insurance. We oversee a multibillion\-dollar market that primarily serves businesses with hard\-to\-place risks. It’s niche, essential and surprisingly interesting.

**Position Overview:** This position is responsible for reviewing insurance policy documents for accuracy, completeness, and adherence to established standards and entering appropriate data into the SLA proprietary database. An Associate will verify broker data, confirm the accuracy of calculated taxes and fees, and accurately record the coverage and industrial operation codes to report to the CDI.


Requirements:
* Compare source document data with database reports to detect errors and ensure completeness and conformity with established policies and procedures. Ensure any needed corrections or changes are accomplished. Notifies Lead Analysts when major errors are detected.
* Work with Lead Analyst to assist brokers with electronic filing questions and surplus lines procedural process questions.
* Respond to broker questions. Monitor status of all open issues to ensure timely resolution.
* Respond to inquiries from brokers in a timely manner. Escalate matters to management as appropriate.
* Gain knowledge of all rules and practices regarding surplus lines law, regulations, and filing procedures.
* Participate in system enhancements and fixes. Identify and report system issues and participate in the testing and resolution of the system fixes when appropriate.
* Achieve established quality and quantity objectives for this position.
* Build proficiency with all programs used in the SLA.
* Build a working knowledge of the organization’s policies and procedures; attend training classes as scheduled.

**Qualifications:**

* Must be a **California** resident.
* Minimum requirement of Associate’s degree and two years of work experience.
* Bachelor's degree with relevant work experience is a plus.
* Insurance experience or knowledge is a plus.

**Benefits \& Perks:**

* Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
* Educational and Professional Development
* 401(k) matching and Roth IRA
* Paid Time Off

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New York, NY, USA; Atlanta, GA, USA; Boulder, CO, USA; Chicago, IL, USA; Los Angeles, CA, USA; Mountain View, CA, USA; San Bruno, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience in management consulting, sales operations, business strategy, or corporate advisory role.
* 3 years of experience working with executive stakeholders.
* Experience using SQL or data analytics tools deliver insights and recommendations.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 2 years of experience creating complex data sets, data modeling, and reporting.
* 2 years of experience in advertising, consultative sales, business development, or a digital media environment.
* Experience in consumer internet and media industries.
* Experience with controlled experiments, causal studies, and communicating technical results to non\-technical audiences.

**About the job**
-----------------


The Business Strategy \& Operations organization provides business critical insights using analytics, ensures cross functional alignment of goals and execution, and helps teams drive strategic partnerships and new initiatives forward. We stay focused on aligning the highest\-level company priorities with effective day\-to\-day operations, and help evolve early stage ideas into future\-growth initiatives.



As a part of The YouTube Ads Go\-to\-Market (GTM) Strategy and Operations team, you will bridge the gap between YouTube Ads product teams and regional commercialization teams. Your mission is to fuel growth by scaling innovation to customers, creators, and viewers by translating global market needs into meaningful product solutions.


The Go\-to\-Market Operations (GtM) team ensures Google's complex and ever\-evolving Ads business runs smoothly. We are instrumental in setting go\-to\-market strategy, and ensuring flawless execution and operations against the strategy. We have teams embedded in each of the major Ads business areas as well as global teams that work across the business areas. Team members are analytical and strategic, with a pragmatic sense of how to get things done.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $124000 \- $177000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Drive hypothesis\-driven business strategy for YouTube products across users, partners, and creators.
* Develop GTM plans, execute communication documents, and lead experiments/trusted tester programs.
* Establish operational excellence by setting and tracking Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) and driving annual business planning.
* Gather market intelligence and conduct analyses and modeling to develop insights and SQL\-based dashboards.
* Build actionable plans and roadmaps and align cross\-functional stakeholders to drive successful implementation of change initiatives.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. new_jobs.title: Project Manager - Telecommunications Transition Planning (DISA/DITCO)
new_jobs.description:
**Cloudnet Systems LLC \| Remote (CONUS) supporting Scott AFB, IL \| Full time \| Start November 6, 2026 (contingent on contract award)**

**About the role**

Cloudnet Systems LLC is preparing a quotation for a five\-year Department of Defense task order supporting the Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA) Defense Information Technology Contracting Organization (DITCO) Transition Program Management Office at Scott Air Force Base, Illinois. The team helps DoD agencies move their telecommunications services from expiring GSA contracts (NETWORX, WITS 3, CVS and regional contracts) to the GSA Enterprise Infrastructure Solutions (EIS) contract and DITCO voice contracts without service disruption. The work covers about 35,000 services, 70,000 service orders and 40 customer data networks over the life of the program.

This is a key personnel position. Your resume will be submitted with our quotation, and you must be available to start full time on November 6, 2026\. The position is contingent on contract award, which we expect to be decided in October 2026\.

**What you will do**

You own the planning documents and schedules that drive DoD agency transitions to new telecommunications contracts, and you keep the program's risks and lessons learned current.

\- Maintain the Transition Strategy and Management Plan, the Transition Project Management Plan and the Transition Master Schedule with the Government PMO.

\- Review individual agency transition plans and regional service plans for feasibility and alignment, and document findings in quarterly Transition Planning Analysis Reports.

\- Maintain the stakeholder register and coordinate with plan authors, customer agencies and GSA EIS contractors on areas of concern.

\- Identify risks, develop mitigation approaches, and maintain the program risk register.

\- Establish and run the lessons learned process and produce the Lessons Learned Report at transition completion.

\- Support integration of all task areas, status reporting and program reviews with the Program Manager.

**Required qualifications**

\- Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution (required, no substitution).

\- U.S. citizenship (required by the contract).

\- Able to obtain a Tier 1 (NACI) background investigation and a DoD Common Access Card. A current Tier 1 or higher investigation is a plus but not required; the Government sponsors the investigation.

\- Available to begin full\-time work on November 6, 2026\.

\- At least 5 years of project management experience on federal IT or telecommunications programs.

\- Demonstrated experience producing integrated master schedules, risk registers and formal planning documents for a Government customer.

**Preferred qualifications**

\- Experience with telecommunications contract transitions or large multi\-agency migrations.

\- PMP certification.

\- Experience with GSA transition plan formats or the EIS transition program.

**Location and schedule**

\- Remote within the continental United States. Occasional travel to Scott Air Force Base, Illinois, to receive or exchange Government equipment.

\- Core hours 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM Central, Monday through Friday. Occasional after\-hours support for service cutovers.

\- Full time, W\-2 employee of Cloudnet Systems LLC.

**Compensation**

$52 to $60 per hour depending on experience.

**How to apply**

Apply with a current resume. Because this position will be submitted as key personnel, we will ask selected candidates to confirm availability for the November 6, 2026 start date and to sign a short letter of intent. Cloudnet Systems LLC is an equal opportunity employer.

Pay: $52\.00 \- $60\.00 per hour

Application Question(s):

* Do you hold a Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution?
* Are you a U.S. citizen?
* Are you available to begin full\-time work on November 6, 2026?
* How many years of experience do you have with telecommunications service ordering, circuit inventory, or network transitions?
* Have you worked on GSA EIS, NETWORX, WITS 3 or DISA telecommunications programs?

Work Location: Remote

 **Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.**

 **Position Title:** Project Manager \- Power Systems Studies

**Position Location:** Remote \- work virtually from anywhere in the United States

**Salary**


DLB recognizes salary ranges from job boards do not necessarily reflect our pay ranges. In many instances we out\-compete those ranges for well\-qualified candidates.

**Job Summary**

We're a Series D company with $325M\+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.


As Headway works to build a new mental healthcare system that everyone can access, we’re facing unique operational challenges and opportunities that come with growing and scaling at an unparalleled rate. We’re pushing the boundaries of the existing healthcare system so that we can fulfill our promise to providers, patients, and payers to create access to high quality providers across the nation. In order to do that, we’re building a world class operations team that enables efficiency, growth, and quality, and as a member of this team, you will have the opportunity to have a material impact on the trajectory of Headway and help define a function core to the livelihood of our business and the impact we deliver for our partners and clients.


As a Business Operations Manager, you will lead high\-impact, cross\-functional initiatives that span teams and pods. You’ll operate as a thought partner to Product, Data, and Operations leaders – helping shape objectives, influence priorities, and translate complex insights into actionable plans. In addition to owning critical operational workflows, you’ll design scalable systems, mentor team members, and drive initiatives that create durable, measurable impact across the organization. This role requires strong judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to drive alignment and execution across the organization.


**What you’ll do at Headway**


* Design and build foundations for a variety of 0\-1 initiatives within the Business Operations function.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally to build, execute, monitor, and implement scalable products and processes that enable us to deliver on core business challenges.
* Assess and analyze data to develop and determine strategies for accelerating progress, proactively identify areas for improvement, and deliver on roadmap priorities and team OKRs.
* Build and manage a growing team to achieve these objectives.

**You’ll be great for this role if you:**


* 7\+ years of experience in operational roles at high\-growth companies, with some background in consulting, finance, business operations preferred but not required.
* Data is your first\-language; you enjoy and are skilled at digging through complex data to solve ambiguous problems.

Solenis is a leading global provider of water and hygiene solutions. The company’s product portfolio includes a broad array of water treatment chemistries, process aids, functional additives, cleaners, disinfectants, and state\-of\-the\-art monitoring, control and delivery systems. These technologies are used by customers to improve operational efficiencies, enhance product quality, protect plant assets, minimize environmental impact, and create cleaner and safer environments. Headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, the company has 78 manufacturing facilities strategically located around the globe and employs a team of over \~23000 professionals in \>160 countries across six continents. Solenis is a 2025 Best Managed Company Gold Standard honoree.


For additional information about Solenis, please visit www.solenis.com or follow us on social media.

**Perks of working with us!**

* Competitive health \+ wellness benefit plan
* Continuous professional development with many opportunities for growth!
* Recharge with 15 days of paid time off
* Competitive Salary and Bonuses

You are responsible for leading and supporting capital projects across the North American plant network. * Lead medium to large\-scale capital projects from concept and feasibility through design, construction, commissioning, and project closeout.

* Support continuous improvement initiatives related to capital planning, project execution, cost management, and reporting.
* Facilitate effective communication between plant leadership, project teams, Finance, Engineering, and senior management.
* Prepare and present project updates and portfolio\-level information to leadership.

 **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Project Management, Business, Finance, or a related technical discipline preferred.
* 10\+ years of experience managing capital projects in a manufacturing, industrial, or similar environment.
* Extensive working knowledge of capital project processes, including budgeting, forecasting, project accounting, and general accounting policies and procedures.
* Strong understanding of project cost management, forecasting, scheduling, and financial reporting.

* Ownership of Safe work environment for projects.

Ability to travel 50\-80%

We're looking for a **Principal Information Security Analyst** to join the Information Risk Management (IRM) team within Corporate Information Security (CIS). This role is a senior individual contributor and program leader who will deliver against an information security and cybersecurity assessment plan integrated into a broader enterprise risk management program supported by executive management.

  

  

You will leverage deep expertise in security policies, standards, controls, and industry best practices to perform and lead risk assessments of Nike systems and systems managed for Nike by vendors. You will also drive strategic advancement of Nike's Third\-Party Risk Management (TPRM) program—establishing risk\-profiling methodologies, tiered assurance frameworks, vendor lifecycle controls, and executive reporting capabilities that protect Nike's most sensitive data across a complex global vendor ecosystem.

You thrive in cross\-functional environments, influence without authority, and bring a principal\-level perspective to program design, not just execution.

  

  

Beyond assessment execution and program delivery, this role carries a broader organizational mandate. You will serve as a recognized subject matter expert in information risk and cybersecurity not only within CIS, but across Nike. Partner teams including Procurement, Legal, Privacy, Engineering, and the broader Nike Business will look to you as a trusted, accessible authority on information risk. You will also identify, initiate, and lead cross\-functional programs that extend beyond IRM’s immediate scope, efforts such as enterprise\-wide data governance alignment or cross\-team risk standardization, bringing structure and momentum to problems that span organizational boundaries.

  

  

**WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON**
-------------------------


This role works with the Information Risk Management team to identify, assess, elevate visibility to, and remediate information security risks across Nike's technology landscape. As a Principal\-level contributor, you will lead high\-complexity assessments, shape team methodology, mentor analysts, and own key TPRM program initiatives.

* **Advance TPRM capability maturity** by designing and implementing program rigor beyond control self\-assessments, including vendor risk profiling, risk\-based controls testing, and tiered assurance requirements
* **Establish and operationalize a standardized vendor risk\-profiling methodology** (e.g., data sensitivity, criticality, regulatory impact) to consistently categorize vendors by inherent risk tier and drive risk\-based assessment prioritization
* **Define and implement tiered assurance requirements** so that higher\-risk vendors undergo deeper validation (evidence reviews, control testing, security baseline documentation) while lower\-risk vendors follow appropriately scaled processes
* **Introduce targeted validation of high\-impact controls** (e.g., access management, data protection, availability) for critical suppliers, going beyond self\-attestation to validate design and operational effectiveness
* **Establish mandatory control effectiveness standards** requiring vendors to demonstrate effective design and operational execution for high\-impact controls prior to contractual engagement or network integration
* **Develop and operationalize TPRM metrics and executive reporting**, including third\-party blind metrics and integration into Executive TPRM Council reporting
* **Expand factory risk assessment program scope** and contribute to assurance activities for Nike's highest\-risk indirect and direct third parties
* **Plan and execute joint response planning tabletop exercises** with key direct and indirect suppliers to validate incident readiness and coordination capabilities
  

  

**Vendor Lifecycle Governance**
-------------------------------

* **Build and steward a centralized vendor inventory** capturing all active vendors, associated services, and data\-sharing agreements, with inventory updates embedded into the global onboarding workflow

* Manage process improvement and strategic initiative workstreams.

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission\-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

We are seeking an experienced **Advanced Security Project Manager** to lead the planning, design, implementation, and delivery of enterprise physical security projects. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical knowledge of electronic access control systems, IP\-based CCTV/video management systems, security networking, and infrastructure deployments, while demonstrating exceptional project management, vendor management, and stakeholder communication skills. new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Company Overview**


Pantheon Data (a Kenific Holding company) is a private, small business based in the Washington, DC, area. Pantheon Data was founded in 2011, initially providing acquisition and supply chain management services to the US Coast Guard. Our service offerings have grown in the past ten years, including infrastructure resiliency, contact center operations, information technology, software engineering, program management, strategic communications, engineering, and cybersecurity. We have also grown our customer base to include commercial clients. The company has used this experience to expand our service offerings to other agencies within the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), the Department of Defense (DoD), and other Federal Civilian Agencies.

**Position Overview**


Pantheon Data is a digital modernization, data, and cloud solutions provider delivering mission\-critical capabilities to federal agencies. We modernize legacy environments, operationalize enterprise data, and field secure, scalable systems in the cloud for our government customers. This position supports deployment of our Theios.AI software platform to multiple DoW clients.


The **Deployment Program Manager** owns the end\-to\-end data integration and secure cloud deployment of our advanced decision support system across multiple enterprise environments. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role accountable for delivery, not solely schedule administration: the successful candidate leads a delivery team, sets technical direction, and is responsible for accreditation\-ready outcomes in secure AWS GovCloud enclaves at Impact Level 4 / Impact Level 5 (IL4/IL5\). The ideal candidate works with the client, and other stakeholders, to define success for their organization and lead the team to achieving it. This includes leading customer discovery to translate mission and operational problems into measurable deployment objectives, technical requirements, success criteria, and prioritized implementation plans.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop detailed implementation plan, schedule, and milestones based on SOW requirements and customer/stakeholder needs.
* Own the data\-integration strategy and execution for the platform across the enterprise data estate: source\-system inventory, ingestion design, transformation, validation, and propagation back to consuming systems and workflows.
* Establish measurable deployment outcomes and drive rapid, incremental delivery of usable capabilities while progressing toward full production deployment and authorization.
* Architect and deploy production systems into AWS GovCloud IL4/IL5 enclaves, owning the path to and maintenance of an Authority to Operate (ATO).
* Lead a working delivery team (hands\-on plus team leadership): manage the backlog, set technical direction, remove blockers, and drive delivery against the priority enterprise problem sets.
* Serve as the embedded technical advocate between the field/deployment team and the product development team \- translating customer problems into well\-formed backlog items and correctly routing platform issues to product engineering.
* In coordination with Clients, own data governance and security posture for the integrated environment: access control, lineage, data quality, and authoritative\-source reconciliation.
* Communicate technical status, dependencies, risks, decisions, and outcomes to Government program leadership, technical stakeholders, and Pantheon leadership.
* Coordinate with government data owners and stakeholders to secure data\-sharing agreements and authoritative\-source access.
* Hire and retain talented engineers and analysts to execute deployment projects.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Bachelor of Science in Engineering, Computer Science, or similar technical degree from an ABET accredited university. Master's degree preferred.
* 10\+ years progressive engineering experience delivering complex systems, with 5\+ years leading technical programs.
* Must have experience managing geographically dispersed, remote teams.
* Demonstrated experience managing contract teams for DoW customers.
* Demonstrated experience developing and implementing solutions for DoW clients.
* Experience managing cross functional teams to define program requirements, system design/development, and satisfy customer mission requirements and operational needs.
* Ability to work effectively remotely in cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to meet deadlines and produce quality work.
* Proficient in Microsoft Suite software including Outlook, Word, Excel, SharePoint, and PowerPoint.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Experience with DoDAF architecture development and system documentation.
* Experience with cloud migration and modernization efforts.
* Hands\-on AWS GovCloud experience and a working understanding of IL4/IL5 accreditation, RMF/ATO, NIST SP 800\-53 Rev 5, FedRAMP High, and DISA STIGs.
* Working command of data governance: cataloging, lineage, data ownership/stewardship, data contracts, and data\-quality frameworks.
* Solutions architecture and DoW proposal writing experience, ideally for OTA or SBIR vehicles.
* Demonstrated experience supporting multiple customers and stakeholders.
* Experience with deploying commercial software to DoW clients.
* PMP or similar certification.

new_jobs.description:
Deputy Program Manager \& OSINT Expert**The Opportunity:**


With all the information available today, it takes a skilled intelligence expert to know how to find and interpret the best data to give their clients the right answers. With critical decisions being made every day, we need an intel analyst like you to do just that. At Booz Allen, you’ll use your industry knowledge to develop solutions within language\-enabled open source intelligence in support of Department of War and Intelligence Community customers. We’re seeking your advanced advisory skills to join our military intelligence programs team to help deliver creative solutions to complex problems.

  

As an open source intelligence expert, you’ll bring your analytical expertise, communication, creativity, critical thinking, and research expertise as we uncover schemes and scenarios that will provide historical conclusions as well as model future events and correlations. You’ll lead a team that uses emerging technologies including data science, automated workflows, and advanced analytics to process metadata and content for discovery purposes.

  

On our team, you’ll guide the development of models with advanced analytics and methodologies such as qualitative and quantitative metric analysis to uncover patterns within complex multi\-variable data. You’ll provide the client with support for the planning and implementation of open source intelligence analysis. You’ll use critical, information\-based research and analysis to relay findings to decision\-makers.

  

You’ll be a trusted advisor and share knowledge and findings including the development and mentoring of others on discovery tradecraft and open\-source research that drive change.

  

Collect, analyze, and deliver intelligence information that keeps people safe.

  

Join us. The world can’t wait.

 **You Have:**

* 8\+ years of experience working with open source and publicly available information
* Experience with managed attribution research capabilities
* Experience with project management for delivery of intelligence products
* Ability to conduct open source research and analysis utilizing proper operational security tradecraft
* TS/SCI clearance
* Bachelor’s degree in Intelligence Studies

 **Nice If You Have:**

* Experience directly supporting military intelligence customers
* Experience with advanced analytic capabilities utilizing AI/ML capabilities
* Ability to speak, read, or write in a foreign language

 **Clearance:**  

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance is required.

**Compensation**


At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well\-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work\-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full\-time and part\-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.


Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract\-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $99,000\.00 to $225,000\.00 (annualized USD). The USCP Office of Information Services keeps the technology running behind a fast\-moving law enforcement operation on Capitol Hill, and its Information Resource Management Division is the group that makes sure IT projects actually get planned, tracked, and delivered. In this role, you will provide IT project management support for up to 10 projects of varying size and complexity, work with USCP OIS staff to ensure adherence to scope, schedule, and budget, track risks and issues to resolution, and report project status to management, staff, and stakeholders. You will apply Agile, Kanban, or Waterfall methodologies as appropriate and monitor project performance using tools such as Microsoft Project, Teams Planner and Planner Premium, SharePoint, and ServiceNow. This is a full\-time opportunity. We can offer a competitive salary, and a comprehensive benefits package.  

Apply today!

* Provides IT project management support for up to 10 projects of varying size and complexity.
* Works with USCP OIS staff to ensure adherence to scope, schedule, and budget
* Assists in defining project scope and objectives with stakeholders
* Prepares and maintains project documentation, including plans, requirements, communications, and agendas
* Identifies and tracks risks and issues through resolution
