### **Position Description \& Qualifications**

  

  

Serco is excited to continue our support for the F\-35 Joint Strike Fighter Program Office (JPO). This contract provides program management support in support of the full acquisition lifecycle of the F\-35 program, to include development, production, and sustainment.


The F\-35 Joint Program Office (JPO) is a joint, multi\-national program and is the Department of Defense’s (DoD) focal point for defining affordable next generation strike aircraft weapon systems among the United States (U.S.) Air Force (USAF), U.S. Navy (USN), U.S. Marine Corps (USMC), and U.S. allies currently composed of seven (7\) cooperative international partners: the United Kingdom, Italy, Netherlands, Canada, Australia, Denmark, and Norway; as well as Foreign Military Sales (FMS) customers. The F\-35 is the next generation strike fighter bringing cutting\-edge technologies to the battle\-space of the future. The F\-35’s advanced airframe, autonomic logistics, avionics, propulsion systems, stealth, and firepower will ensure that the F\-35 is the most affordable, lethal, supportable and survivable aircraft ever to be used by so many warfighters around the world. The JPO is a product\-aligned organization comprised of Program Management Offices (PMOs) designed to deliver five major products across the acquisition lifecycle: Air Vehicle, Propulsion, Combat Data Systems, Training Systems \& Simulation, and Maintenance Systems.

new_jobs.title: Deputy Program Manager, NASA AEGIS Program
new_jobs.description:
**Description**


The Digital Sector at Leidos currently has an opening for a **Deputy Program Manager** to help provide program leadership to NASA to support a complex set of enterprise IT services, including network infrastructure, data center operations, cloud computing and cybersecurity. In this position you will serve as a direct report to the Program Manager within Leidos for the NASA AEGIS Program. The **Deputy Program Manager** will be responsible for assisting the Program Manager with achieving financial, service delivery, customer satisfaction, and growth objectives. The position can be located onsite at any NASA Center. The AEGIS program is NASA’s largest IT infrastructure services contract, supporting enterprise IT and mission systems across data centers, cloud platforms, networks, collaboration tools, voice over IP, and cybersecurity. As part of the AEGIS leadership team, you will directly influence how NASA evolves to support missions on Earth, in space, and beyond.

**POSITION SUMMARY:**
---------------------


The ideal candidate is a trusted technical advisor, a strategic thinker, an energetic people leader, and a recognized subject matter expert with broad experience across enterprise IT domains. The **Deputy Program Manager** must be able to create and maintain a collaborative work environment; set goals; give clear direction to the team and provide decisive and constructive feedback; empower individuals to take ownership for their assignments; facilitate identification and capture of funded program growth; and demonstrate and insist on ethical and professional behavior in accordance with company values. This person will help manage a complex IT service delivery program involving multiple tasks, multiple customer organizations, and complex responsibilities.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:**
-----------------------------


Strategic Leadership

* Build strong relationships with senior NASA and Leidos leadership to ensure alignment with agency priorities.
* Lead engineering across all AEGIS technologies including data centers, cloud, networking, VoIP, cybersecurity, and collaboration services.
* Continuously assess enterprise system baselines and recommend improvements to support modernization.
* Translate NASA OCIO and Office of Engineering objectives into actionable engineering priorities, plans, milestones, and measurable outcomes.
* Provide direct leadership of the Collaboration Services \& Specialized Services Portfolio Managers. These portions of the contract support the Conference Room standardization and operation efforts, as well as work packages that are individually funded by NASA Centers and OCIO organizations outside of the Network and Compute Infrastructure Services (NCIS) OCIO Service Line.
* Foster a culture of innovation, learning, and accountability.
* Mentor leaders at all levels on career growth, skills, and technical decision making.
* Communicate clear expectations, provide timely feedback, and model strong leadership behaviors.
* Promote collaboration across the program and within Leidos.

  

Planning, Governance \& Integration

* Understand contract technical requirements and guide the team toward solutions meeting user needs and contract obligations.
* Support AEGIS program governance to ensure transparency on status, schedules, dependencies, risks, constraints, and required decisions.
* Implement structured methods for identifying, prioritizing, escalating, and resolving risks and issues.
* Support the Program Manager with integration with the Leidos Corporate business rhythms, including Monthly Operating Reviews (MORs), Integrated Program Reviews (IPRs), Financial Risk \& Ops Reviews, Annual Operating Plans.
Assist in facilitation of internal program business rhythms, including ability to stand in for PM with COR, CO, Center CIO and Service Line Leadership integration points.  
* 

  

  

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**
-------------------------

* Bachelor's degree and 15\+ years of prior relevant experience or Master's and 10\+ years of prior relevant experience.
* Strong leadership abilities; detail\-oriented; effective under deadlines.
* At least 7 years of experience with the management, manpower utilization, and supervision of employees (including subcontractors) of various labor categories and skills in projects.
* Proven Program Management experience across CPAF, and FFP contracts. This includes experience managing contract deliverable items, budgets, customer satisfaction.
* Proven experience and interaction with senior level customers (SES and above).
* Experience in effectively capturing on contract growth.
* Experience managing IT contracts with focus on Customer Relationship Management across multiple stakeholder communities.
* Demonstrated success building relationships with customers and teammates.
* Ability to effectively communicate when briefing Leidos and NASA senior leadership.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**
-----------------------------

* ITIL Certification.
* SAFe® Agile Product Manager or Lean Portfolio Manager.
* Project Management Professional (PMP)® Certification.
* Experience working with NASA or other federal agencies
* Technical knowledge across one or more of the following technologies:
	+ Network Solutions (e.g., LAN, WAN, SDA, SD\-WAN)
	+ Data Center Technologies (e.g., Virtualization, Capacity Management, Data Backup)
	+ Cloud\-based Architectures (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP)
	+ Collaboration Services (e.g., Conferencing, VoIP)

**CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS:**
---------------------------

* U.S. Citizenship is required.
* Must have the ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance ranging from a **Public Trust, at minimum, up to a Top Secret clearance**, as required.


If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient

new_jobs.description:
**Date:** Sep 22, 2026


**Location:** Arlington, VA, Virginia, United States


**Company:** HII's Mission Technologies division


Requisition Number: 30354


Required Travel: 0 \- 10%


Employment Type: Full Time/Hourly/Non\-Exempt


Anticipated Salary Range: $71,811\.00 \- $135,000\.00


Security Clearance: Secret


Level of Experience: Mid

  

This opportunity resides with **Warfare Systems (WS)**, a business group within HII’s Mission Technologies division. Warfare Systems comprises cyber and mission IT; electronic warfare; and C5ISR systems.


HII works within our nation’s intelligence and cyber operations communities to defend our interests in cyberspace and anticipate emerging threats. Our capabilities in cybersecurity, network architecture, reverse engineering, software and hardware development uniquely enable us to support sensitive missions for the U.S. military and federal agency partners.

  

**Leadership Mindset at HII – Mission Technologies**


Leadership at HII is a mindset, not a title. Through our Leadership Capability Framework, we define how every employee grows, leads, and contributes—regardless of role. It sets the standard for how you can develop yourself and what you can expect from leaders across our organization. We look for candidates who want to grow in alignment with these capabilities:  

  

  



* **Know \& Grow Your People** – Commit to learning and supporting team success.
* **Build Relationships** – Communicate openly, collaborate well, and build trust.
* **Take Ownership** – Deliver on commitments and take pride in your work.
* **Customer First** – Focus on the mission and those we serve.
* **Shape the Future** – Bring ideas, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
* **Act with Urgency** – Take initiative and follow through with purpose.

These capabilities guide how all employees contribute to our shared success across Mission Technologies.  

  

  



**Job Description**
-------------------


HII – Mission Technologies is seeking a Data Analyst to support the Department of War (DoW) Chief Information Officer (CIO). If you’re excited about contributing to a major IT modernization effort with real mission impact, we would love to hear from you.  

  



In this role, you will help advance a large‑scale IT transformation initiative aimed at strengthening readiness, improving system performance, and supporting critical decision\-making. You will work closely with technical and mission stakeholders to ensure data quality, accessibility, and integration across modernized platforms.

  

This position requires a SECRET security clearance and is onsite in Arlington, VA.

  

We encourage all levels of applicants to apply.

  

LEVEL 2 \- $73,025 \- $104,321


LEVEL 3 \- $94,520 \- $135,028


LEVEL 4 \- $118,192 \- $168,845

  

**Essential Job Responsibilities**
----------------------------------


* Analyze large, complex datasets from multiple legacy and modernized systems to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities for optimization.
* Collaborate with software engineers, system architects, and cybersecurity teams to ensure data integrity and accessibility across modernization efforts.
* Translate technical data findings into clear, actionable recommendations for both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Support data integration activities, ensuring accuracy and compliance with Department of War (DoW) data governance standards.
* Contribute to the development of data quality metrics and automated validation processes.
**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------


* LEVEL 2 \- 3 years relevant experience with Bachelors in related field; 1 year relevant experience with Masters in related field.
* LEVEL 3 \- 6 years relevant experience with Bachelors in related field; 4 years relevant experience with Masters in related field.
* LEVEL 4 \- 10 years relevant experience with Bachelors in related field; 8 years relevant experience with Masters in related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 14 years relevant experience.
* Strong understanding of relational databases, ETL processes, and data warehousing concepts.
* Familiarity with DoW compliance frameworks (e.g., FISMA, NIST)..
* Excellent communication, organizational skills, and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a structured environment; collaborative team mindset.
* Clearance: A SECRET level security clearance is required.
**Preferred Requirements**
--------------------------


* TS/SCI is preferred.
**Physical Requirements**
-------------------------


* May require working in an office, industrial, shipboard, or laboratory environment. Capable of climbing ladders and tolerating confined spaces and extreme temperature variances.
  
  

The listed salary range for this role is intended as a good faith estimate based on the role's location, expectations, and responsibilities. When extending an offer, HII's Mission Technologies division takes a variety of factors into consideration which include, but are not limited to, the role's function and a candidate's education or training, work experience, and key skills.
  

  

**Meet HII’s Mission Technologies Division**
  

Our team of more than 7,000 professionals worldwide delivers all\-domain expertise and advanced technologies in service of mission partners across the globe. Mission Technologies is leading the next evolution of national defense – the data evolution \- by accelerating a breadth of national security solutions for government and commercial customers. Our capabilities range from C5ISR, AI and Big Data, cyber operations and synthetic training environments to fleet sustainment, environmental remediation and the largest family of unmanned underwater vehicles in every class. Find the role that’s right for you. Apply today. We look forward to meeting you.
  

  

To learn more about Mission Technologies, click here for a short video: https://vimeo.com/732533072

new_jobs.title: Investigative Intelligence Analyst
new_jobs.description:
**About Agile Defense**

At Agile Defense we know that action defines the outcome and new challenges require new solutions. That’s why we always look to the future and embrace change with an unmovable spirit and the courage to build for what comes next.

Our vision is to bring adaptive innovation to support our nation's most important missions through the seamless integration of advanced technologies, elite minds, and unparalleled agility—leveraging a foundation of speed, flexibility, and ingenuity to strengthen and protect our nation’s vital interests.  

**Requisition \#:** 1867
**Job Title:** Investigative Intelligence Analyst
**Location:** Rosslyn VA
**Clearance Level:** TS / SCI Eligibility to Start  



### **Job Description**


The Investigative / Intelligence analyst will apply project management, open\-source research, behavioral threat assessment and management, threat assessment, and Program legal and policy guidance, together with strong writing and editing skills, to support longer\-term research, production, field support, investigations and office improvement initiatives. The Analyst is expected to work autonomously, contributing meaningfully to initiatives even in the absence of clear tasking, and must maintain a high degree of organization across concurrent responsibilities. The Analyst will be expected to contribute significantly to larger office initiatives and to independently lead projects of medium complexity. The Analyst must be highly communicative, with the ability to coordinate effectively across groups and to brief initiative status to the government on a regular basis, both formally and informally. The Analyst is expected to adjust their work in response to government feedback and shifting priorities. Strong written communication is essential: the Analyst must write clearly and concisely in accordance with approved Program templates and style guides and must be able to edit products drafted by other personnel to ensure quality and consistency. The Analyst will advise the government on the status of current initiatives and recommend new or improved approaches where appropriate. In addition, the Analyst will collaborate with Business Analysts, Automation Engineers, and other personnel to identify processes and sub\-processes suitable for automation and will support the development of process and functional requirements documentation in furtherance of these automation efforts.

**Responsibilities/Duties:**

* **Monitor Classified Intelligence.** Continuously review and research classified cable traffic and other intelligence reporting to identify potential direct and indirect threats relevant to U.S. diplomatic facilities and personnel, as well as to other U.S. interests overseas. Maintain situational awareness based on classified reporting during breaking events overseas.
* **Evaluate Dissemination Criteria.** Assess classified intelligence to determine whether it meets predefined threat criteria for dissemination to operational stakeholders.
* **Disseminate Threat Intelligence.** Quickly generate and distribute short, templated threat notifications to overseas security personnel, domestic desk officers and analysts, and external agencies.
* **Support Data Calls/Requests for Information.** Answer requests for information from Senior Watch Officers, office management, and other partners while staying within the bounds of mission requirements. As needed, may provide information in both written and oral briefing formats.
* **Databases and Information Logging.** Maintain classified and unclassified data logs for disseminated notifications and leverage intelligence toolkits and databases to support threat warning operations.
* **Conduct Cross\-Network Operations.** Monitor reporting on a TS/SCI network while disseminating information through a Secret network.
* **Manage Workload.** Operate autonomously, managing time effectively while adhering to established processes and procedures.
* **Collaborate with Stakeholders.** Work closely with colleagues and organizational partners to obtain and share security\-related intelligence, ensuring timely awareness of relevant threat reporting.

### **Education and Background**

* Bachelor's degree plus 5 years of relevant experience.

### **Required Skills**


* Prior experience monitoring, researching, and disseminating security and/or threat\-related intelligence reporting, particularly in a U.S. government or Department of State context.
* Strong ability to identify relevant intelligence and generate accurate, timely, concise synopses of reports.
* Ability to follow established processes, procedures, and written templates.
* Proficiency in databases and tools used to access and disseminate classified information.
* Strong skills in oral and written communication to present clear, concise information overviews.
* Ability to manage time and work independently to achieve assigned tasks, while also taking direction from both mid\- and senior\-level supervisors responsible for management of complementary information\-sharing missions.
* Strong interpersonal skills, capable of working effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
* Highly collaborative, with the ability to interact effectively and professionally with individuals at all levels.
* Customer service mindset, with a strong desire to meet customer needs within established mission parameters.
### **Preferred Skills**


* Previous experience working on a watch floor, particularly if involved in threat warning and/or intelligence operations.
* Familiarity with Department of State and other U.S. government agency missions, databases, search platforms, information handling systems, and/or law enforcement databases and tools.
**Our Core Values**

Employees of Agile Defense are our number one priority, and the importance we place on our culture here is fundamental. Our culture is alive and evolving, but it always stays true to its roots. Here, you are valued as a family

* Produce analytic products and assessments that support operational planning, targeting, and strategic assessments.

**Technical Program Manager, Federal Deployment and Authorization (DHS/CBP)**


*Sayari • Government Solutions • Washington, DC*


**About Sayari**



Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. The Sayari Commercial World Model resolves 10\.6B\+ primary\-source records from 250\+ jurisdictions forming the ground truth of global commerce. A Judgment Ontology, encoding over a decade of investigative tradecraft, and Superconductor, an agentic orchestration platform, deliver AI that reasons like an expert analyst, shows its work, and traces every finding to its source. Trusted by U.S. Customs and Border Protection, the U.S. Treasury, and Fortune 500 enterprises, Sayari is used by thousands of professionals across 35\+ countries to secure supply chains and dismantle illicit networks. Headquartered in Washington, D.C.


**Position Description**



Sayari is hiring a Technical Program Manager to own delivery of an enterprise program deploying the Sayari Platform inside U.S. Customs and Border Protection. The program has two parallel tracks: configuring the platform for CBP mission workflows, and taking the system through the DHS security authorization process (Authority to Operate) so it can process live government data. You own the plan, the dependencies, and the accountability for both.



Federal deployments take several forms: a Sayari\-operated enclave in a government cloud region, a deployment into an agency\-provisioned cloud tenancy, or an on\-premises installation. Each changes who provides the security controls, who may access the environment, what personnel security is required, and how long authorization takes. You will build the schedule around those tradeoffs.



Senior individual contributor based in the Washington, D.C. area. Expect to be on\-site at CBP \[2 to 3 days per week], more during kickoff and assessment fieldwork. Much of the job is producing documents the government will read, sign, or act on, so clear writing matters. Reports to the SVP of Government Solutions and Services.


**How This Role Fits the Team**


* **Forward Deployed Engineers** configure the platform, write infrastructure\-as\-code, build the agents that automate CBP workflows, and implement technical controls.
* **The Account Executive** owns the commercial relationship, executive sponsorship, and expansion.
* **You** turn contract obligations into a plan and the plan into weekly accountability for Sayari, subcontractors, and the government. In every CBP working session, you convert open questions into written decisions with an owner and a date.


**Job Responsibilities**


**Program Ownership**


* **Integrated program plan**: Build and maintain the master schedule for deployment and authorization: work breakdown, critical path, dependencies, and explicit allowances for each government\-side gate.
* **Contract delivery**: Own scope, schedule, and contractual milestones from award through go\-live. Track every deliverable, key personnel requirement, and reporting obligation.
* **Deployment model decisions**: Lead the analysis of hosting and boundary options with Sayari Security, Infrastructure, and the FDE team. Present the tradeoffs to CBP and Sayari leadership and drive a decision.


**Security Authorization (ATO)**


* **Run the authorization program**: Own Sayari's side of the NIST Risk Management Framework process under DHS policy, from kickoff to ATO letter. Sequence and track every package artifact, from categorization and System Security Plan through Security Assessment Report and POA\&Ms.
* **Coordinate the producers**: Partner with the Sayari Security team, who own control implementation and package content, and with Infrastructure and the FDEs, who build the environment the package describes.
* **Manage the assessors**: Contract and manage the independent third\-party assessor. Schedule a readiness review before formal fieldwork, close remediation before submission, and keep the government's Security Control Assessor engaged throughout.
* **Work the government gates**: Coordinate with the CBP System Owner, ISSO, ISSM, CISO, Privacy Office, and Authorizing Official through document review and the authorization decision.
* **Ongoing authorization**: After the ATO, establish the continuous monitoring, change control, POA\&M, and annual assessment cadence, then hand it to a steady\-state owner.


**Compliance Workstreams**


* **Privacy**: Coordinate the Privacy Threshold Analysis, Privacy Impact Assessment, and System of Records Notice determinations, and deliver the technical content (data elements, flows, retention, retrieval paths) the government needs to complete them.
* **Accessibility**: Manage Section 508 conformance: Trusted Tester coverage, test plan and results, remediation, and the Accessibility Conformance Report.
* **Operational obligations**: Security operations and monitoring arrangements, incident reporting timelines, supply chain and software attestations, and government\-furnished information handling.


**Personnel Security**


* **Clearance pipeline**: Own pre\-screening, background investigation tracking

---------------


The Design, Sustainability and Engineering team in GREF seeks an experienced Program Manager with strong cross\-functional leadership skills to own GREF’s Global Furniture Fixtures \& Equipment (FF\&E) Program. This role is the single point of strategic ownership for FF\&E lifecycle management, procurement strategy, asset management, and cross\-functional coordination across GREF's worldwide workplace portfolio.  

  

The FF\&E function within GREF covers four primary responsibilities: defining and maintaining FF\&E standards and strategy, stewarding the Workplace FF\&E Standards, driving regional procurement strategies, sustainability, and benchmarking against industry practice to identify gaps and improvements.  

This role serves as the connective tissue between Global Design, Workplace Guidelines, Construction delivery teams, GREF Finance, Global Corporate Sustainability, Portfolio Management, and Global Corporate Procurement (GCP). The successful candidate will integrate constraints and requirements from cross\-functional stakeholders into efficient, scalable, globally\-relevant solutions that are fiscally responsible and advance Amazon's sustainability commitments.

* Own the end\-to\-end FF\&E Lifecycle Management Strategy across GREF's global portfolio — from specification and procurement through operations, storage, and end\-of\-life disposition.
* Own and drive the FF\&E procurement strategy, partnering with GCP under the shared\-accountability model to co\-own joint savings commitments while balancing regional availability, sustainability, and cost caps
* Own global FF\&E Asset Tracking (AST) strategy across all GREF\-supported sites, including asset storage, product ordering, inventory management, and evaluation of aging products to meet requirements of 100% inventory coverage and \>90% data quality accuracy. Develop and enforce governance, risk and compliance controals for FF\&E including monthly verification tracking, sadhbaords scopes and compliance evidence documentation
* Establish and maintain furniture asset lifetime guidelines, condition assessment criteria, and refurbishment standards that inform replacement planning, budget forecasting, and warranty alignment

This role is deeply cross\-functional. The role will also include consulting with clients, delivering presentations, resolving project issues, recommendations for new services or enhancements, estimating, proposal writing, project costs management, directing operations on labor requirements, directing/assisting purchasing with bill of materials.
  
The Assistant Project Manager is responsible for assisting in the entire successful execution of a project. Their primary responsibilities are to plan, direct, coordinate, and budget activities concerned with the construction of their project. The Assistant Project Manager shall also participate and at times lead the conceptual development of a construction project and oversee its organization, estimating, scheduling, and implementation.
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

The Assistant Project Manager is accountable for effective project management and delivery of their projects. The APM will work with the extended site team and the PM to develop the program schedule and establish key milestones for delivery of the program ensuring all financial targets and schedule targets are met in alignment to the customers goals. The APM will assist the PM to identify and acquire all resources required revising as appropriate to meet changing needs and requirements.
  
  

During the pre\-construction phase, continuously evaluate the materials and products being proposed for constructability and feasibility. Oversee and at times prepare the cost estimate at multiple stages. Initiate and coordinate the design efforts and the value engineering processes.
  
  

Schedule the project in logical steps and budget time required to meet deadlines.
  
  

Determine labor requirements and dispatch workers to construction sites.
  
  

Facilitate travel for technicians traveling to the project site.
  
  

Coordinates with the superintendent.
  
  

Inspect and review projects to monitor compliance with codes and other regulations.
  
  

Interpret and explain plans and contract terms to staff, workers, and clients, representing the owner.
  
  

Prepare contracts and negotiate revisions, changes and additions to contractual agreements with designers, consultants, clients, suppliers and subcontractors.
  
  

Obtain all necessary permits and licenses.
  
  

Direct and supervise team members in the office and on site.
  
  

Study job specifications to determine appropriate construction means and methods.
  
  

Solicit, negotiate, select, contract, and oversee material suppliers, subcontractors who complete specific pieces of the project.
  
  

Requisition supplies and materials to complete construction projects.
  
  

Prepare and submit budget estimates and progress and cost tracking reports.
  
  

Develop and implement quality control programs
  
  

Take action to deal with the results of delays, bad weather, or emergencies at the construction site.
  
  

Confer with supervisory personnel, owners, contractors, and designers to discuss and resolve matters such as work procedures, complaints, and construction problems.
  
  

Plan, organize, and direct activities concerned with the construction and maintenance of structures, facilities, and systems.
  
  

Investigate damage, accidents, or delays at construction sites, to ensure that proper procedures are being carried out.
  
  

Evaluate construction means and methods to determine cost\-effectiveness of plans.
  
  

Manage, cost/budget, and communicate the contract changes process.
  
  

Developing and maintaining the project schedule
  
  

Develop and maintain the project financial plan
  
  

Prepare, maintain, and complete all aspects of the DL Way (project management playbook).
  
  

Completes all weekly and monthly reporting and projections.
  
  

Train and develop project team
  
  

Invoicing client
  
  

Equipment and material purchasing
  
  

The Assistant Project Manager helps to review job cost postings for accuracy and completeness, including but not limited to, the preparation of invoices, customer collections and periodic financial reporting to the customer and management.
  
  

The APM will additionally manage all associated aspects, directed by the PM of the program including the Safety \& Environment program, the quality assurance program and material logistics.
  
  

The Assistant Project Manager will manage all human resource issues (and escalate as needed) per Company policies and procedures.
  
  

Coordinate and partner effectively with internal and external design, construction, network, and facility partners.
  
  

Proactively communicate program status and risks to all stakeholders
  
  

Prepare and take corrective action to address concerns and challenges.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Do you thrive on transforming complex operational challenges into streamlined automated solutions? The ILS Delivery \& Execution (D\&E) organization is seeking a technical leader to deliver on some of our most critical and strategic initiatives, supporting our growing fleet. You'll spearhead initiatives to improve the condition of Amazon's branded fleet across North America, and be on the forefront of emerging programs within the ILS org to build the execution framework of the future. Working along\-side ILS Strategy teams, and across GFP field and program teams, you'll leverage your expertise to align stakeholder (internal an external) to deliver scalable solutions that impact millions of customers worldwide.  

  

This role offers a unique opportunity to understand end\-to\-end functions of ILS and while serving as a technical expert and critical leader for emerging initiatives. You'll partner with cross\-functional teams to identify automation opportunities, design robust forecasting models, and implement solutions that enhance operational efficiency at scale.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Drive end\-to\-end program management for large\-scale automation initiatives that eliminate redundant tasks and improve operational efficiency across D\&E functions
* Create E2E execution requirements and for emerging programs to ensure operational feasibility, collaborating with strategy and field teams to deliver scalable solutions.
* Lead cross\-functional alignment between Strategy teams, Field/Operations teams, and Vendors to identify optimization opportunities and implement data\-driven solutions
* Proactively identify risks and dependencies across complex technical programs, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and driving resolution of technical and operational blockers

  

A day in the life  

Your day will be a dynamic blend of strategic thinking and hands\-on problem\-solving. You'll collaborate with cross\-functional teams, dive deep into operational challenges, and offer simple and effective solutions. You might start by reviewing automation metrics from recent deployments, then transition to a design session with engineers on new forecasting algorithms, followed by stakeholder meetings to align on program priorities and remove blockers.  

  

About the team  

This role exists within the D\&E (execution) organization, part of the In\-Life Services organization, as a strategic leader for program implementation and execution. Our team focuses on optimizing asset utilization and availability through innovative technology solutions that directly impact customer delivery experiences.  

We're building the future of fleet sustainable solutions by leveraging best practices and developing scalable solutions across our evolving and growing fleet. Join us in creating scalable solutions that enhance operational excellence while fostering an inclusive environment where technical innovation drives measurable business impact.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 2\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
* Knowledge of general AI tools
* Experience designing, implementing, and scaling upskilling, apprenticeship, or workforce development programs across large\-scale operations or corporate environments, including forecasting workforce needs and leveraging analytics to drive program decisions

new_jobs.description:
Washington Navy Yard, District of Columbia, US, 20374
Category: Navy
Job ID: 35393
widget: Full\-Time
Secret
No \- Teleworking not available for this position
$78073\.24\-$130122\.06
  
### **Position Description \& Qualifications**

  

  

If you seek a rewarding, high profile and challenging position supporting projects for the US Navy\- Serco has a terrific opportunity for you!


As the HR Analytics Specialist, you will be on a dynamic team providing technical and programmatic support to the U.S. Navy’s Team Submarine Program Offices! Bring your expertise and collaborative skills to make an impact on our military defense and safety of our sailors and contribute and influence the Navy's future, premier nuclear submarines.


**Must possess an active U.S. Department of War (DoW) Secret security clearance**


Team Submarine unites the Program Executive Officer, Undersea Warfare Systems (PEO UWS); the Deputy Commander, Undersea Technology (SEA 07\); Program Executive Officer, Attack Submarine (PEO SSN); Program Executive Officer, Strategic Subs (PEO SSBN) and the Submarine Maintenance Engineering, Planning, and Procurement (SUBMEPP) Activity, once diverse submarine\-related commands and activities, into a single "submarine\-centric" team. Conceived to increase efficiencies within the submarine acquisition, maintenance, and modernization communities, Team Submarine eliminates traditional "stovepipe" structures and processes that created impediments and inefficiencies in the submarine research, development, acquisition, and maintenance communities. Team Submarine provides improved communication among the various offices that contribute to the overall success of the United States Submarine Force.


We are looking for an energetic, enthusiastic and exceptional person to serve as a highly skilled HR Analytics Specialist with strong expertise in SharePoint development, list management, and workflow automation in the Washington, DC area. In this role, you will bridge the gap between HR data analytics and process optimization. The ideal candidate will be responsible for extracting and analyzing HR data to deliver actionable insights, while simultaneously maintaining, updating, and automating our HR data analytics through our SharePoint infrastructure and workflows. This is a hands\-on technical role involves working directly with HR staffing and classification team, requiring a blend of analytical mindset, system administration skills, and process automation expertise


In this role, you will:


* Provide input to analysis of programs to determine manpower resources necessary to meet program requirements.
* Utilizes modeling and analytic skills to determine costs associated with those resources. Examines identified personnel requirements and capabilities to optimize workforce and missions.
* Familiar with a variety of field concepts, practices, and procedures.
* Rely on experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals.
* Performs a variety of complicated tasks, such as:
* + Update, restructure, and clean up existing SharePoint lists, document libraries, and metadata columns to support HR processes.
	+ Design and build new SharePoint lists, custom views, and user forms to capture HR data efficiently.
	+ Manage and audit user permissions, group access, and security configurations within SharePoint Online to ensure strict confidentiality of sensitive HR data.
	+ Improve the user interface (UI) and user experience (UX) of our internal HR SharePoint pages.
	+ Design, build, and troubleshoot automated workflows and SharePoint lists (using Microsoft Power Automate / Microsoft Flow) which assist our HR staffing teams track workload.
	+ Set up automated email alerts, approval flows, and status updates linked to SharePoint lists.
	+ Integrate SharePoint Online with other Microsoft 365 applications (such as Teams, Power BI, Outlook, and Power Apps) to create seamless, automated end\-to\-end solutions.
	+ Extract, clean, and analyze complex HR datasets from various systems (e.g., payroll, performance, recruiting, demographics).
	+ Develop and maintain automated HR dashboards, reports, and key performance indicators (KPIs) using tools like Power BI or Advanced Excel.
	+ Deliver insights and trends related to employee retention, turnover, headcount, and other critical HR metrics to support decision\-making.
	+ Identify data quality issues within SharePoint and connected systems, implementing corrective actions to maintain data integrity.

To be successful in this role, you will have:


* Bachelor’s degree in business, technical field, or managerial discipline, or commensurate additional, related experience.
* **Must possess an active DoW Secret security clearance.**
* Minimum 2 years of experience in HR Analytics, HR Systems Administration (HRIS), Business Intelligence, or a closely related technical HR role.
* Advanced level understanding of DoD and US Navy mission, purpose, function and organization.
* Significant experience related to US Navy programs or operations.
* SharePoint development or Microsoft Power Apps experience.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (Pivot Tables, Power Query, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, index\-matching, and data formatting).
* Professional experience building interactive reports and dashboards in Power BI.
* M365 Ecosystem: Strong understanding of the broader Microsoft Office 365 environment (Teams, Power Apps, Forms, Outlook).
* To be able to travel 10%.

Desired Education and Experience:


* Knowledge of Navy, NAVSEA or Team Submarine Human Capital policies and processes.

If you feel your skillset is a match to the requirements, then you should be ready to take the next step of your career path, apply today!

  

  

### **Company Overview**

  

  

Serco Inc. (Serco) is the Americas division of Serco Group, plc. In North America, Serco’s 9,000\+ employees strive to make an impact every day across 100\+ sites in the areas of Defense, Citizen Services, and Transportation. We help our

new_jobs.description:
**Summary**
-----------


The position serves as the Management and Program Analyst, GS\-0343\-9 FPL 11, located in the Office of Community Supervision and Intervention Services within Court Services and Offender Supervision Agency for the District of Columbia (CSOSA). CSOSA provides community supervision of adult offenders released by the DC Superior Court or the United States Parole Commission on probation, parole and supervised release in the District of Columbia.


Learn more about this agency


  
**This job is open to**
-----------------------


### **The public**


U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.
### **Career transition (CTAP, ICTAP, RPL)**


Federal employees whose job, agency or department was eliminated and are eligible for priority over other applicants.
### **Veterans**


Veterans of the U.S. Armed Forces or a spouse, widow, widower or parent of a veteran, who may be eligible for derived preference
### **Clarification from the agency**


United States Citizens


  
**Duties**
----------


* Performs a variety of duties related to the research, data collection and analysis, and identification of criminal activities and enterprises in the Washington, DC, Metropolitan Area to support the effective community supervision of adult probationers.
* Monitors case status changes and produces intelligence reports for consumption by internal stakeholders to support staff safety and close supervision.
* Utilizes a variety of internal and external databases and open sources to assist supervision staff, management, and other senior leadership with analysis of offender involvement in criminal activity and compliance with supervision.
* Collaborates with other law enforcement agencies on straightforward intelligence\-gathering problems, such as identifying intelligence gaps.
* Participates in collaborative multi\-agency task forces authorized by the Agency Director to further intelligence gathering and assist partners in investigations by assembling, collating, coordinating, and analyzing reports and evidence.
* Participates in public meetings to provide intelligence\-data and reports.
* Performs routine and non\-complex tasks to assist in the development and maintenance of relationships with law enforcement stakeholders. Assists in developing and implementing plans for disseminating routine information about a specific intelligence discipline and/or program.

  
**Requirements**
----------------


### **Conditions of employment**


* Must be a U.S. Citizen or National
* Males born after 12\-31\-59 must be registered for Selective Service, if applicable
* Background security investigation, drug test, and favorable adjudication
* Time\-in\-grade requirements must be met within 30 calendar day of the closing date of this announcement
* CSOSA uses E\-Verify, if you are selected for this position, the documentation that you present for purposes of completing the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Form I\-9 will be verified through the DHS "E\-Verify" System.
* All Federal employees are required to have Federal salary payments directly deposited into a financial institution of their choosing.
* This is not a virtual or remote position; you must live within or be willing to relocate within a commutable distance of the duty location which is Washington D.C. (District of Columbia).

### **Qualifications**


**GS\-09 Qualifications**  

**To minimally qualify for this position at the GS\-09 grade level, you must meet all the following requirements:**  

**One year of specialized experience** equivalent in level of difficulty and responsibility to that of the next lower grade (GS\-07 or equivalent in other pay scales) within the federal service, which demonstrates the ability to perform the duties of the position, is required.  

**Specialized Experience is defined as** performing **developmental\-level analytical and evaluative work** related to administrative, operational, or program activities. Examples include:
* Applying **basic analytical and evaluative techniques** to identify and resolve procedural or factual issues.


* Conducting **research, data collection, and analysis** to identify patterns, issues, or trends relevant to program operations.


* Using **qualitative and quantitative analytical techniques** to support studies or projects.


* Assisting in reviewing and evaluating **information sources**, assembling corroborating data, and supporting routine intelligence or administrative inquiries.


* Preparing routine **written materials**, guides, instructions, or summaries to transmit information.


* Providing routine support in maintaining communication with internal and external stakeholders.


**Knowledge Required:**


* Applicants must demonstrate on their resume, knowledge of:
* Analytical and evaluative methods for resolving factual or procedural issues.
* Management and organizational theory, administrative practices, and work processes.
* Basic intelligence techniques, information sources, and the criminal justice system.
* Qualitative and quantitative analytical approaches.

**OR**  

  

**Substitution of Education for GS\-09 Specialized Experience**: Two full years of progressively higher\-level graduate education, **Master's or equivalent graduate degree**, or LL.B. or J.D., if education is related, may be substituted to meet the specialized experience requirement. Equivalent combinations of successfully completed graduate level education and experience may be used to meet total experience requirements. **If you are using education to substitute for the specialized experience, you must submit transcripts at the time you apply.** To be creditable, education must have been obtained in an accredited college or university recognized by the U.S. Department of Education

**One year

The Junior Business Analyst will support business process discovery, stakeholder engagement, process mapping, requirements gathering, and documentation efforts across multiple Agile workstreams. The role will assist senior analysts in developing current\-state and future\-state process documentation and identifying opportunities for process improvement.

* Conduct stakeholder interviews and workshop support activities.
* Develop and maintain As\-Is and To\-Be process documentation.
* Create process maps, swim lanes, journey maps, and workflow diagrams.
* Capture requirements, business rules, and operational procedures.
* Document roles, responsibilities, dependencies, and pain points.
* Support business process analysis and recommendation development.
* Maintain project repositories and process documentation.
* Assist with sprint planning and backlog development activities.
* Support executive briefing development and meeting preparation.

* Must be able to OBTAIN and MAINTAIN a Federal or DoD "PUBLIC TRUST"; candidates must obtain approved adjudication of their PUBLIC TRUST prior to onboarding with Guidehouse. Candidates with an ACTIVE PUBLIC TRUST or SUITABILITY are preferred.
* Must be a US Citizen due to nature of client engagements.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Information Systems, Operations, or related field.
* Two (2\+) plus years of business analysis or process improvement experience.
* Knowledge of requirements elicitation techniques.
* Familiarity with BPMN, UML, swim\-lanes, and journey mapping.
* Strong analytical, communication, and documentation skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office products.
* Work from client office in Washington, DC and Guidehouse office in Tyson's Corner, VA.

* Experience supporting federal agencies or financial regulators.
* Exposure to Agile project delivery methodologies.
* Experience working with Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.
* Experience supporting data\-intensive or analytical organizations.
* Interest in process improvement and modernization initiatives.

Are you an experienced identity or intelligence analyst ready to use advanced data, analytics, and LexisNexis tools to deliver mission‑critical insights that support law enforcement and government operations?


**About the Business:**

LexisNexis® Risk Solutions provides customers with solutions and decision tools that combine public and industry specific content with advanced technology and analytics to assist them in evaluating and predicting risk and enhancing operational efficiency. We use the power of data and advanced analytics to help our customers make better, timelier decisions. By bringing clarity to information, we ultimately help make communities safer, insurance rates more accurate, commerce more transparent, business decisions easier and processes more efficient. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at the link below,


risk.lexisnexis.com


**About the Team:**

LexisNexis Special Services Inc. (LNSSI) was established to support government agencies in generating actionable intelligence and enabling informed, data\-driven decisions. The organization is committed to continuous innovation, consistently delivering advanced solutions to our government partners to address some of the nation’s most complex and pressing challenges. As a Senior Identity Data Analyst, you will leverage advanced, cutting\-edge technologies to conduct comprehensive due diligence, perform in\-depth analytical reporting, and collaborate closely with customers, engineers, and operational personnel in a dynamic, time\-sensitive environment.


**About the Role:**

A Senior Data Analyst I should have a solid understanding of best practices and can execute on projects and initiatives without supervision from others. Individuals will create advanced\-level insight and recommendations in their area of expertise. A Senior Data Analyst I is subject matter expert in their domain. Individuals in this role lead analytics effort with high complexity, mostly independently.


**Responsibilities:**

* Conducting rigorous analysis of relevant data sources to investigate, interpret, and produce actionable intelligence.
* Responding with agility to evolving priorities and requirements, effectively managing and prioritizing tasks to maximize efficiency.
* Developing and delivering high\-impact, professional solutions tailored to the needs of the customer
* Applying a deep understanding of customer’s objectives, challenges, and risks to design and deliver optimal solutions.
* Collaborating cross\-functionally with internal stakeholders to support strategic planning and the development of future solutions.
* Making empowered, timely well\-informed decisions based on available data, situational context, and customer requirements.
* Maintaining comprehensive knowledge of both internal and external data sources, ensuring accuracy and relevance in all analyses.
* Proactively supporting colleagues and leadership in strengthening relationships with customers and internal stakeholders to drive service solutions and positive business outcomes.
* Developing and sustaining strong customer relationships by advising on best practices, procedures, and methodologies to promote engagement and customer advocacy.
* Delivering clear, concise, and timely communications aligned with business standards to key internal stakeholders and external customers.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education, professional experience and/or military service.
* **U.S. citizenship** and **Active TS clearance** is required, at a minimum.
* Law Enforcement or government contractor experience preferred but not required.
* Extensive experience supporting Law Enforcement or a government agency, either as a direct employee or as a contractor.
* Proven ability to independently review, interpret, and comply with government contracts, regulations, and standard operating procedures.
* Must have extensive knowledge of public records and good understanding of personal, commercial, and/or Governmental data sources and their applications.
* Comprehensive knowledge of LexisNexis tools, platforms, and products.
* Proficiency in data analysis tools and technologies to support advanced analytical workflows and reporting.
* Demonstrated leadership capabilities, with strong analytical, organizational, and written and verbal communication skills.

**Disclaimer** :


Physical and/or logical access to criminal justice information is an essential function of this role. Employees in this role may also be subject to ongoing criminal background checks as required by the Company’s state and local law enforcement partners. new_jobs.description:

At Noblis and Noblis ESI, we have excellent teams of smart, collaborative, proactive experts and professionals. We are actively seeking a Senior Technical Program Analyst focused on logistics and field operations to support a DHS mission and CBP technology program that identifies, evaluates, documents, and transitions emerging commercial technologies for operational users.  

DHS and CBP mission partners need practical execution support that connects planning, field logistics, stakeholder coordination, asset tracking, sustainment, and transition documentation. The Senior Technical Program Analyst will bring a technical program mindset and strong logistics experience to keep complex technology activities organized, traceable, and ready for operational use. **Role Focus: This role is intended for a highly experienced logistician and technical program operator who can manage field execution details, coordinate moving parts, and proactively contribute wherever the mission needs disciplined follow\-through.** **These technologies stem from new and emerging commercial technologies.** **This work is performed on client site in Washington, DC or at remote sites as required in accordance with the requirements of the contract. new_jobs.title: Operations Analyst for Undersea Warfare
new_jobs.description:
**Description**  

Do you have experience investigating and solving complex issues, and conveying analysis to a variety of audiences?  

  

Are you interested in applying your skills to critical problems supporting national security? **If so, we're looking for someone like you to join our team at APL.**  

We are seeking an operations analyst to provide technical contributions and leadership to support continued American undersea superiority. We are a hardworking team of analysts and operators who apply the latest technology to important problems supporting the US Navy Sea Control Mission. Our group strives to cultivate an environment of innovation while working on complex technical challenges that contribute to the security of the United States! **As an Operations Analyst for Undersea Warfare...*** Your primary responsibility will be to analyze and evaluate Concepts of Operations (CONOPs) of Undersea Warfare (USW) and Anti\- Submarine Warfare (ASW) platforms and sensors.
* Technical contributions may include problem definition, requirements and metrics development, system assessment, analysis of mission success, and documentation.
* You will work with analysis teams and systems authorities to evaluate and assess measures of performance and measures of effectiveness for USW and ASW systems.
* This will include evaluation of factors such as system performance, logistic requirements, costs, operational impacts, and potential CONOPs, the results of which will be detailed in reports and annotated briefs for delivery to Department of War (DoW) sponsors.
* You will interact with DoW and or Navy staff to facilitate task execution and work prioritization.
* This includes briefing the sponsor or DoW command staff on the insights of the work and possible participation in field tests or sea trials for USW or ASW platforms and sensors.


  

**Qualifications** **You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you...*** Have a Bachelor's Degree with five or more years of relevant USW/ASW operational/technical experience.
* Are technically and analytically oriented and possess curiosity about USW/ASW systems and work well in an innovative team environment with a proven ability to lead small teams.
* Have initiative, motivation and flexibility, and possess strong analytical, operational, problem solving and organizational skills.
* Are willing and able to travel (i. e., occasional 2\- 3 day trips or week long tests), are willing to work on dynamic projects, and can prioritize a number of concurrent taskings.
* Hold an active Top Secret level security clearance. If selected, you will be subject to a government security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U. S. citizenship..

 **You'll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you...*** Have a Master's degree in Engineering, Physics, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research or relevant technical field.
* Have demonstrated understanding of features and patterns in data that identify the characteristics and behaviors of systems or components.
* Have an understanding of potential adversary defensive and offensive capabilities.


  

**About Us** **Why Work at APL?**


The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) brings world\-class expertise to our nation’s most critical defense, security, space and science challenges. While we are dedicated to solving complex challenges and pioneering new technologies, what makes us truly outstanding is our culture. We offer a vibrant, welcoming atmosphere where you can bring your authentic self to work, continue to grow, and build strong connections with inspiring teammates.


At APL, we celebrate our differences of perspectives and encourage creativity and bold, new ideas. Our employees enjoy generous benefits, including a robust education assistance program, unparalleled retirement contributions, and a healthy work/life balance. APL’s campus is located in the Baltimore\-Washington metro area. Learn more about our career opportunities at https://www.jhuapl.edu/careers.


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, occupation, marital or familial status, political opinion, personal appearance, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. APL is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to individuals of all abilities, including those with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in any part of the hiring process, please contact Accessibility@jhuapl.edu.


The referenced pay range is based on JHU APL’s good faith belief at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training and skill level with consideration for internal parity. For salaried employees scheduled to work less than 40 hours per week, annual salary will be prorated based on the number of hours worked. APL may offer bonuses or other forms of compensation per internal policy and/or contractual designation. Additional compensation may be provided in the form of a sign\-on bonus, relocation benefits, locality allowance or discretionary payments for exceptional performance. APL provides eligible staff with a comprehensive benefits package including retirement plans, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short\-term disability, long\-term disability, flexible spending accounts, education assistance, and training and development. Applications are accepted on a rolling basis.

  

  

**Minimum Rate**  

  

$100,000 Annually
  

  

**Maximum Rate**  

  

$245,000 Annually

new_jobs.description:
Overview:

Systems Planning and Analysis, Inc. (SPA) delivers high\-impact, technical solutions to complex national security issues. With over 50 years of business expertise and consistent growth, we are known for continuous innovation for our government customers, in both the US and abroad. Our exceptionally talented team is highly collaborative in spirit and practice, producing Results that Matter. Come work with the best! We offer opportunity, unique challenges, and clear\-sighted commitment to the mission. SPA: Objective. Responsive. Trusted.  

The Joint, Office of the Secretary of Defense, Interagency Division (JOID) provides expert support services to a range of customers spanning across the Department of Defense, Federal Civilian, and international markets. JOID provides a diverse portfolio of analytical and programmatic capabilities to help our customers make informed decisions on their most challenging issues.  

JOID assists the Defense Threat Reduction Agency (DTRA) in developing leading edge technologies to counter WMD in support of Combatant Commands (CCMDs) and transitioning these technologies to military services CCMDs. SPA provides expertise across the full range of chemical, biological, radiological, nuclear, and high\-yield explosives (CBRNE) WMD, Counter Improvised Threat and Countering Threat Network technologies to support understanding, detection, identification, characterization, denial, control, disabling, defeating, disposing, safeguarding the force, managing consequences, and test and evaluation in support of military and civilian operations.  

We have an immediate need for an Operations Research Analyst to provide onsite support in Lorton, VA, at the DTRA headquarters.
Responsibilities:

The candidate will support the Defense Threat Reduction Agency (DTRA), Research and Development\-Chemical Biological Department (RD\-CB), Enabling Science (CBE) Division, Information Sciences Branch (CBEI). Assist in the following: digesting program gaps and requirements, assist in developing project capability research and development to address these gaps, analyzing proposal responses, advising on recommended path along with recommended modifications, and monitoring research project progression and actively analyze when a pivot in course of action are needed. Apply a solid understanding of chemical and biological agent threat modeling and simulation tools, data handling, and software development in this space. Support the management of technical projects that focus on the development of models, algorithms, and software assets aimed at aiding decision\-makers predict, understand, and mitigate warfighter exposure threats in CB contested environments. Apply subject matter knowledge to extract usable information from various sources to aid in decision\-making, analyze information for technology trends, and advise on the technical soundness of performer\-developed algorithms, models, and capabilities. Prepare technical documentation and briefings to explain the performer\-developed tool methodologies, associated assumptions, and conclusions derived from CB software capabilities. Collaborate with the Project Management team on acquisition and procurement tasks while assisting the Government with ensuring assigned portfolios are valuable and aligned to program goals. Contribute to analyzing, developing, and presenting strategic alignments to capability gaps, tracking and advancing transitions, and assisting with taskers for the assigned portfolio in line with the division’s vision and mission. Apply expertise in analyzing, interpreting, and applying modeling tools and an understanding of DoD initiatives aimed at closing knowledge gaps by supporting foundational research, hazard modeling, and data/computer science to support the warfighter. Stay abreast of current novel science and technology (S\&T) in the field while exhibiting programmatic skills to trace capabilities to stakeholder requirements. Review technical reports, experimental or theoretical techniques, and scientific studies to ensure technical validity while evaluating current and future technologies.  

The position is for in\-person work at DTRA HQ in Lorton, VA, at least 4 days a week to complete mission objectives.

* Ability to accomplish tasks with minimal supervision and a demonstrated proactive work approach, with a strong sense of accountability, work ethic, and punctuality.

new_jobs.description:
Founded in 1977 as the Senior Care Action Network, SCAN began with a simple but radical idea: that older adults deserve to stay healthy and independent. That belief was championed by a group of community activists we still honor today as the “12 Angry Seniors.” Their mission continues to guide everything we do.


Today, SCAN is a nonprofit health organization serving more than 500,000 people across Arizona, California, Nevada, New Mexico, Texas, and Washington, with over $8 billion in annual revenue. With nearly five decades of experience, we have built a distinctive, values\-driven platform dedicated to improving care for older adults.


Our work spans Medicare Advantage, fully integrated care models, primary care, care for the most medically and socially complex populations, and next\-generation care delivery models. Across all of this, we are united by a shared commitment: combining compassion with discipline, innovation with stewardship, and growth with integrity.


At SCAN, we believe scale should strengthen—not dilute—our mission. We are building the future of care for older adults, grounded in purpose, accountability, and respect for the people and communities we serve.

**The Job**


The Associate Project Manager \- Retention Campaign Specialist supports the planning, execution, and delivery of retention and renewal campaigns across markets. This role works closely with Retention Specialists, Data \& Analytics,  

Product, Pharmacy, Member Services, Sales, and other cross\-functional teams to ensure campaign activities are organized, timely, within scope, and measurable.

new_jobs.title: Implementation Manager
new_jobs.description:
Implementation Manager  


Location: El Segundo, California, USA (HQ)  
Reports To: Director of Implementation  
Role Type: Full\-Time, On\-Site  


Compensation: $80,000\.00 \- $100,000  


About QuikStor  


QuikStor is the leading SaaS facility management platform for the self\-storage industry, delivering a purpose\-built, scalable system that serves as the foundation for intelligent automation and modern facility operations. We are in rapid growth mode, backed by significant capital from self\-storage industry veterans who share our vision to build the most advanced and scalable operating system for storage operators worldwide.  


Role Overview  


The Implementation Manager is a customer\-facing, product\-expert role responsible for translating a customer’s business requirements into a clearly defined QuikStor system configuration. This role sits between Sales, Project Management, and Implementation Execution, and is critical to ensuring successful, scalable deployments.  


Implementation Managers are not project managers and are not solely focused on task tracking or timelines. Instead, they serve as trusted advisors and product experts who understand both QuikStor and the self\-storage industry. They work directly with customers to define workflows, configurations, and operational requirements, then hand off clear, complete implementation specifications to the Implementation Execution team.  


Success in this role is measured by implementation quality, customer confidence, reduction in rework, and smooth handoff to execution teams.  


Key Responsibilities  


Customer Discovery \& Requirements Definition  


Lead detailed discovery sessions with customers to understand their operational workflows, policies, and business requirements  
Advise customers on best practices and recommended configurations within the QuikStor platform  
Identify gaps between current customer processes and QuikStor\-native workflows, and guide customers toward scalable solutions  


Product Configuration \& Solution Design  


Define how QuikStor should be configured to meet customer needs, including leasing, billing, delinquency, access control, reporting, and integrations  
Translate customer requirements into clear, structured implementation specifications  
Ensure configurations align with QuikStor best practices, compliance requirements, and long\-term scalability  


Implementation Handoff \& Execution Support  


Deliver clean, complete handoff documentation to the Implementation Execution team  
Partner closely with Project Management to ensure scope, assumptions, and dependencies are clearly understood  
Support the Execution team during build and validation phases by answering questions and clarifying requirements  


Cross\-Functional Collaboration  


Work closely with Sales to support pre\-implementation alignment and expectation setting  
Partner with Product to provide feedback on configuration gaps, edge cases, and customer needs  
Collaborate with Support to ensure smooth post\-go\-live transitions  


Customer Confidence \& Enablement  


Serve as a trusted product expert for customers throughout the implementation lifecycle  
Help customers understand not just how the system is configured, but why  
Reduce post\-launch issues by ensuring customers are properly aligned and educated during implementation  


Required Qualifications  


3 to 6\+ years of experience in SaaS implementation, onboarding, or solutions consulting  
Deep understanding of complex, configurable B2B SaaS platforms  
Strong customer\-facing communication and discovery skills  
Ability to translate business requirements into clear technical and functional specifications  
High attention to detail and strong documentation discipline  
Comfortable working in a structured, multi\-team implementation model  
Ability to operate independently while collaborating across functions  


Preferred Qualifications  


Prior experience in the self\-storage industry  
Experience implementing property management, proptech, or operational SaaS platforms  
Familiarity with access control systems, payments, accounting workflows, or compliance\-driven processes  


Location \& Work Environment  


This role is based at QuikStor headquarters in El Segundo, California. Regular on\-site presence is expected to support close collaboration with Sales, Project Management, Product, and Implementation teams. Travel of approximately 10 to 20 percent may be required for customer meetings or implementation\-related activities.  


Benefits  


Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance  
401k Retirement Plan  
Vacation and Sick Time  
20 Remote Workdays per Year  
Annual Bonus  
Employee Assistance Program  
Education Assistance Program  
Employee Discount Store  
Discounted Storage  
Equity Opportunities  


QuikStor is an equal opportunity employer. QuikStor does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion or religious creed, national origin or place of origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding or related medical conditions), physical or mental disability, age, protected military or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, genetic information, legally protected medical condition, marital or domestic partner status, status as a victim of domestic violence (including sexual assault or stalking), or any other basis protected by applicable law.  


Qualified applicants with criminal histories will be considered for employment in a manner consistent with all federal state and local ordinances. We are committed to offering reasonable accommodation to job applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at hr@kobreco.com

**POSITION:** CSI Intelligence Analyst  

**DEPARTMENT:** Community Security Initiative  

**NON\-UNION / EXEMPT**  

**SALARY:** $85,000 \- $90,000  

**TIME LIMITED:** 12/31/2027 (extension depending upon 3\-year grant funding)


**SUMMARY DESCRIPTION OF POSITION:**  

Reporting to the CSI Operations Supervisor, Analysis Center, and working out of the CSI Analysis Center, the CSI Intelligence Analyst will collect, monitor, analyze, and disseminate open\-source information with a threat nexus to the Jewish community in the Los Angeles and surrounding regions. The CSI Intelligence Analyst is responsible for the production of intelligence products, as well as the regular monitoring of online open sources for potential security and operational threats.


**PRINCIPAL DUTIES:**  

* Conduct regular monitoring of online open sources and social media for known and potential threats to community security and organizational reputation.
* Produce actionable intelligence products in a timely manner on threat actors targeting regional Jewish community.
* Conduct research on wide range of issues pertaining to regional security, such as: terrorism, hate groups, crime trends, disruptive protests, weather conditions, natural disasters, reputational concerns, as well as socio\-economic dynamics.
* Monitor, collect, vet and disseminate regional information and intelligence to CSI staff and partner Jewish institutions.
* Utilize structured analytic techniques to recognize trends, patterns, and potential emerging threats to the regional Jewish community.
* Conduct presentations on various topics of concern to CSI Analysis Center and other pertinent stakeholders.
* Monitor critical event management platform for situational awareness alerts affecting Jewish institutions in catchment area and respond appropriately.
* Keep meticulous records of incidents, entities, and any associated data through corresponding case management platform.
* Liaise with local, national, and international Jewish community security groups.
* Stand duty as off\-hours CSI Duty Officer as assigned, taking incident reports, monitoring situational awareness alerts, and processing associated emergency alert notifications.

**ADDITIONAL DUTIES:**  

Be available to supervisor for additional assignments, as required, including assisting with the Campaign.


**EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE REQUIRED FOR POSITION:**  

* Bachelor’s Degree in Regional Studies, Strategic Studies, International Relations, Political Science, Economics or equivalent military/professional intelligence training.
* Minimum 3\+ years’ academic or professional experience in intelligence analysis, research, and development of intelligence products/reports.
* Knowledge of foreign and domestic violent extremists and threat landscape facing the Jewish community.
* Strong familiarity with all major social media platforms, both mainstream and alternative.
* Experience conducting OSINT collection in gaming, messaging, and live\-streaming platforms a plus.
* Knowledge of Jewish community in the Greater Los Angeles region a plus.
* Experience with investigative and risk management tools desired.
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills with experience collecting and analyzing data to produce notifications, assessments, and reports.
* Excellent time management, communication, technical writing, presentation, and organizational skills required.
* Must be flexible and possess the ability to function in demanding environment.
* A dependable team player with business maturity, enthusiasm, and a positive attitude.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, CEM platforms, case management, and analytical/data mining software.
* A hybrid work model will be implemented for certain positions. This position must report to the worksite on non\-remote workdays, as determined by the Federation.

**Team:** Operations

**About Plug**
--------------


Plug is an automotive fintech startup building the marketplace for electric vehicles. Consumers, dealers, and commercial partners trade in, sell, and auction used EVs through a platform built exclusively for electric, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive.


Consumers can get an instant cash offer in minutes, backed by data\-driven pricing, battery state\-of\-health analysis, with pickup, payment, and title transfer handled end\-to\-end. Founded in 2023 and led by former Tesla executives, Plug has facilitated $100M in EV sales since launch and is backed by a $20M Series A from Lightspeed Venture Partners. We're building the most AI\-native startup team in Los Angeles, full of operators, engineers, and ML researchers laying the transaction rails for the used EV market's exponential growth.

------------

* You'll own a piece of the biggest infrastructure opportunity in automotive.
* You'll work on a platform built exclusively for EVs, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive.
